It defines a sell signal when close is above the sell EMA multiplied by high_offset. It has a -0.06 stoploss, no trailing stop, and use_sell_signal is False.

families.name: ElliotV8_IF3_futlo
families.idea_html: ElliotV8_IF3_futlo: On a 5m timeframe, it enters long when RSI and fast RSI are below thresholds, EWO is either above ewo_high or below ewo_low, and close is below both buy and sell EMA offsets, with positive volume. It exits long when RSI > 50, fast RSI > slow RSI, close is above HMA50, and close is above the sell EMA high_offset_2. Although can_short is True, the shown entry code only sets enter_long; it uses a trailing stop and -0.32 stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it enters long when RSI and fast RSI are below thresholds, EWO is either above ewo_high or below ewo_low, and close is below both buy and sell EMA offsets, with positive volume. It exits long when RSI > 50, fast RSI > slow RSI, close is above HMA50, and close is above the sell EMA high_offset_2. Although can_short is True, the shown entry code only sets enter_long; it uses a trailing stop and -0.32 stoploss.

On a 5m timeframe, it enters long when RSI and fast RSI are below thresholds, EWO is either above ewo_high or below ewo_low, and close is below both buy and sell EMA offsets, with positive volume. It exits long when RSI > 50, fast RSI > slow RSI, close is above HMA50, and close is above the sell EMA high_offset_2. Although can_short is True, the shown entry code only sets enter_long; it uses a trailing stop and -0.32 stoploss.

families.name: Flawless_Lambo
families.idea_html: Flawless_Lambov2: On 15m it buys when volume is positive, OBV slope and +DI slope are positive, Williams %R is below -66, and close crosses above the lower Bollinger band. It sells when close is above the upper Bollinger band, +DI slope is negative, Williams %R is at or above a configured level, and RSI is at or above a configured level. It uses a 15% stoploss, a minimal ROI schedule, and optional trailing sell handling.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 15m timeframe it buys when the close crosses back above the lower Bollinger band while Williams %R is below -66, OBV slope is positive and +DI slope is rising. It sells when the close is above the upper Bollinger band with a falling +DI slope and Williams %R and RSI at or above configurable thresholds, and can also start a trailing sell order in live/dry-run mode. Exits additionally come from the minimal ROI table and the stoploss is disabled at -1.

This 15m strategy enters when the close crosses above the lower Bollinger band together with Williams %R below -66, positive OBV slope and a rising +DI slope. The sell side triggers when the close is above the upper Bollinger band while +DI slope falls and Williams %R and RSI reach configurable sell levels, optionally followed by a trailing sell order. Minimal ROI and stoploss -1 handle the remaining exits.

families.name: FreqGym
families.idea_html: FreqGym_2: It calculates a large set of TA features including DMI, ADX, Williams %R, CCI, RSI, Fisher, Aroon, AO, UO, and EWO. Entry and exit are delegated to an RL model prediction: buy when action equals 1 and sell when action equals 2. It uses startup_candle_count 200, stoploss -0.99, and a minimal ROI schedule.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy calculates a large set of normalized oscillators and trend features, including ADX, RSI, CCI, Williams %R, EWO and Aroon. Entries and exits are driven solely by an RL model prediction: buy on action 1 and sell on action 2. It has a -0.99 stoploss, no trailing stop, and a minimal ROI set to 100.

This strategy computes normalized oscillators and trend indicators such as ADX, RSI, CCI, Williams %R, EWO and Aroon. The entry and exit rules are produced by an RL model prediction, buying on action 1 and selling on action 2. It uses a -0.99 stoploss, no trailing stop, and a minimal ROI of 100.

families.name: FreqaiExampleStrategy
families.idea_html: FreqaiExampleStrategy: It runs a FreqAI model to generate do_predict and a predicted close return (& -s_close). It enters long when do_predict is 1 and the predicted return is above 0.01, and enters short when it is below -0.01. Long exits when the predicted return falls below 0, short exits when it rises above 0, with a -0.05 stoploss and 10% initial ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It runs FreqAI over multiple timeframes and correlation pairs, then computes target_roi and sell_roi from the predicted close mean and standard deviation. It enters long when do_predict is 1 and the predicted close return exceeds target_roi, and defines a short entry when it falls below sell_roi. Exits use scaled versions of those thresholds, with a -0.05 stoploss and 10% initial ROI.

It runs a FreqAI model and computes target_roi and sell_roi from the predicted close mean and standard deviation. It enters long when do_predict is 1 and the predicted close return exceeds target_roi, and defines a short entry when it falls below sell_roi. Exits use scaled versions of those thresholds, with a -0.05 stoploss and 10% initial ROI.

families.name: Infinity
families.idea_html: Infinity: Infinity trades on 5m and merges BTC and informative-timeframe data. The visible entry code assembles parameterized buy-protection filters such as EMA, price-above-EMA, and rising SMA200 conditions, but the actual buy trigger is not shown. The sell signal is disabled (set to 0), so exits rely on custom_sell, ROI, trailing stop, and a 30% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Infinity_0 trades on 5m and merges BTC and informative-timeframe data. The visible entry code assembles parameterized buy-protection filters such as EMA, price-above-EMA, and rising SMA200 conditions, but the actual buy trigger is not shown. The sell signal is disabled (set to 0), so exits rely on custom_sell, ROI, trailing stop, and a 20% stoploss.

Infinity_1 trades on 5m and merges BTC and informative-timeframe data. The visible entry code assembles parameterized buy-protection filters such as EMA, price-above-EMA, and rising SMA200 conditions, but the actual buy trigger is not shown. The sell signal is disabled (set to 0), so exits rely on custom_sell, ROI, trailing stop, and a 15% stoploss.

families.name: JohnisHyperOpt
families.idea_html: JohnisHyperOpt: JohnisHyperOpt trades on 1m. It buys dips when close is below EMA14 times a factor and RSI4/RSI14 are below configured limits, with BTC-safety and anti-pump filters. It exits on a Fisher level together with declining Heikin-Ashi highs/closes and a price/BB-middle condition, using ROI, no trailing stop, and an 8.5% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: JohnisHyperOpt2 trades on 1m. It buys dips when close is below EMA14 times a factor and RSI4/RSI14 are below configured limits, with BTC-safety and anti-pump filters. It exits on a Fisher level together with declining Heikin-Ashi highs/closes and a price/BB-middle condition, using ROI, trailing stop, and a 33.1% stoploss.

JohnisHyperOpt3 trades on 1m. It buys dips when close is below EMA14 times a factor and RSI4/RSI14 are below configured limits, with BTC-safety and anti-pump filters. It exits on a Fisher level together with declining Heikin-Ashi highs/closes and a price/BB-middle condition, using ROI, no trailing stop, and a 99% stoploss.

families.name: LS
families.idea_html: LSV1: On 15m with shorting enabled, it builds long entries when trend_close EMAs for multiple horizons are above both Ichimoku Senkou A and B, with the number of higher-timeframe checks controlled by buy_trend_above_senkou_level. Short entries are mirrored. Exits occur when trend_close_5m crosses the configured exit indicator, with stoploss -0.275 and tiered minimal ROI; trailing stop is off.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m with shorting enabled, it builds long entries when trend_close EMAs for multiple horizons are above both Ichimoku Senkou A and B, with the number of higher-timeframe checks controlled by buy_trend_above_senkou_level. Short entries are mirrored. Exits occur when trend_close_5m crosses the configured exit indicator, with stoploss -0.275, trailing stop on, and tiered minimal ROI.

On 15m with shorting enabled, it builds long entries when trend_close EMAs for multiple horizons are above both Ichimoku Senkou A and B, with the number of checks controlled by buy_long_trend_above_senkou_level. Short entries are mirrored. Exits occur when trend_close_5m crosses the configured exit parameter, with stoploss -0.125, trailing stop on, and tiered minimal ROI.

families.name: MACD
families.idea_html: MACD: On the 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when MACD is above its signal line and CCI is at or below -50. It exits when MACD is below its signal line and CCI is at or above 100. It uses a trailing stop, a -15.29% stoploss, and a multi-step minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when at least one oversold condition is met (MFI below a parameter, Fisher RSI below a parameter, or stochastic fastk below 20 with fastd above fastk) and MACD is below zero, crosses above its signal line, and Bollinger gain is at least a parameter. It exits when MFI is above a parameter, SAR is above the close, and Fisher RSI is above a parameter. It uses a trailing stop, a -33.2% stoploss, and a multi-step minimal ROI.

On the 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when at least one oversold condition is met (MFI below a parameter, Fisher RSI below a parameter, or stochastic fastk below 20 with fastd above fastk) and MACD is below zero, crosses above its signal line, and Bollinger gain is at least a parameter. It exits when MFI is above a parameter, SAR is above the close, and Fisher RSI is above a parameter. It uses a trailing stop, a -33.2% stoploss, and a multi-step minimal ROI.

families.name: MFI
families.idea_html: MFI: On the 5m timeframe, enters when the previous MFI value is at or below 14. Exits when MFI is at or above 75. Uses a -0.10 stoploss and a minimal ROI ladder.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The entry is built from optional parameter-gated conditions, such as close below EMA5, RSI above a threshold, DM delta positive, MFI below a threshold, close below SAR, Fisher RSI below a threshold, negative MACD, or Bollinger gain above a threshold. Exits are either disabled or trigger when close is above EMA5 and MFI is above a configured sell threshold. The sheet does not show which conditions are enabled or their concrete threshold values.

Buys when a set of oversold/dip conditions align, including close below EMA5, MFI at or below a threshold, Fisher RSI below a threshold, MACD below zero, close below SAR, and Bollinger-band gain above a threshold, with optional RSI and DM filters. Exits when close is above EMA5 and MFI exceeds a sell threshold, unless sell-hold is enabled. Timeframe and risk settings come from Config.

families.name: MacheteV8b
families.idea_html: MacheteV8b: Buys when any of many named buy-signal functions fires and the informative timeframe shows SSL up above SSL down, up-trend positive, and go-long positive. Exits when SSL down crosses above SSL up and either Tenkan crosses below Kijun or close crosses below Kijun. Timeframe is 15m, stoploss is -0.1, and custom_stoploss is present.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Buys when any of many named buy-signal functions fires, with informative SSL up above SSL down, up-trend positive, and EWO above a configured high threshold. Exits when SSL down crosses above SSL up and either Tenkan crosses below Kijun or close crosses below Kijun. Timeframe is 15m, stoploss is -0.05, and custom_stoploss is present.

On a 5m timeframe it merges higher-timeframe informative data and calls offset and bbrsi buy-signal helper methods to set the buy flag. The sell signal uses higher-timeframe SSL and Ichimoku crosses plus SMA/offset and RSI fast/slow conditions. It has stoploss -0.05 and a custom_stoploss hook.

families.name: Markov
families.idea_html: Markov: On 30m candles it fits a two-regime Markov regression using returns and exogenous volume-gap and fractal-high/low features. Long entries require prob_up > 0.8 with prob_side and prob_down below 0.5; sell signals require prob_down > 0.8 with prob_up and prob_side below 0.5. Stoploss is -0.05.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 30m candles it fits a three-regime Markov regression on an initial 50% training slice and applies it forward using returns and volume/fractal exogenous features. Long entries require prob_up > 0.8 with prob_side and prob_down below 0.5; sell signals require prob_down > 0.8. Stoploss is -0.05.

On 30m candles it fits a three-regime Markov regression using next-close change as the endogenous variable and volume-gap, daily-change, and fractal-high/low as exogenous variables. Long entries require prob_up > 0.8 with prob_side and prob_down below 0.5; sell signals require prob_down > 0.8. Stoploss is -0.05.

families.name: MiniLambo
families.idea_html: MiniLambo: On 1m candles it looks for a long entry when close is below EMA14 by a factor, RSI4 and RSI14 are below limits, and two percentage-change conditions are met. It does not use a sell signal and exits through minimal ROI, stoploss -0.10, or the custom_stoploss hook. The entry is mean-reversion style because it buys weakness below the EMA and low RSI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1m candles it looks for a long entry when close is below EMA14 by a factor, RSI4 and RSI14 are below limits, and two percentage-change conditions are met. It does not use a sell signal and exits through minimal ROI, stoploss -0.10, or the custom_stoploss hook. The entry is mean-reversion style because it buys weakness below the EMA and low RSI.

This strategy overrides indicators and buy-trend to call the parent strategy and manage a trailing buy order in live/dry-run. When the parent buy signal appears it can start trailing, and if a trailing order is already started it manually sets buy=1 to continue that trail. The exit trend code is empty; timeframe and stoploss are not shown in the sheet.

families.name: MultiMa
families.idea_html: MultiMa: On 4h candles it builds a sequence of SMAs from buy_ma_gap and enters long when, for all configured shifts, each longer SMA is above the previous shorter SMA. The sell condition requires the opposite SMA ordering for sell MAs. It uses minimal ROI and stoploss -0.1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 4h timeframe, it computes multiple TEMA periods with increasing gaps. It enters long when all shorter-period TEMA values are above the corresponding longer-period TEMA values, and exits when any longer-period TEMA moves above a shorter-period TEMA. Stoploss is -0.345, trailing stop is off, and minimal ROI is 0.523 falling to 0.

On a 4h timeframe, it builds SMA pairs with increasing periods. It buys when all longer-period SMAs are above the next shorter-period SMAs, and sells when any longer-period SMA falls below a shorter-period SMA. Stoploss is -0.1, trailing stop is off, and minimal ROI is 0.30873 falling to 0.

families.name: NASOSv5_mod
families.idea_html: NASOSv5_mod1: On 5m candles, it buys when fast RSI is low, price is below the buy moving average by an offset, EWO is above a threshold, and RSI is low. It exits on an overbought RSI/momentum condition or when price is below HMA50 while above a sell moving average. Stoploss is -0.3, trailing stop is enabled, and minimal ROI is 0.4 at 0 minutes.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys when fast RSI is low, price is below the buy moving average by an offset, EWO is above a threshold, and RSI is low; the first setup also requires RSI below 31. It exits on an overbought RSI/momentum condition or when price is below HMA50 while above a sell moving average. Stoploss is -0.3, trailing stop is enabled, and minimal ROI is 0.4 at 0 minutes.

On 5m candles, it buys when fast RSI is low, price is below the buy moving average by an offset, EWO is above a threshold, and RSI is low; the first setup also requires RSI below 44. It exits on an overbought RSI/momentum condition or when price is below HMA50 while above a sell moving average. Stoploss is -0.3, trailing stop is enabled, and minimal ROI is 0.4 at 0 minutes.

families.name: NFI46Offset
families.idea_html: NFI46Offset: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative indicators, entry requires a 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising SMA200, together with dip conditions such as RSI and MFI below thresholds or close under a lower Bollinger band offset. Exit signals fire when RSI is high and close has been above the upper Bollinger band for six consecutive candles. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI starts at 1.3%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative indicators, entry requires a 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising SMA200, together with dip conditions such as RSI and MFI below thresholds or close under a lower Bollinger band offset. Exit signals fire when RSI is high and close has been above the upper Bollinger band for six consecutive candles. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI starts at 1.3%.

On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative indicators, entry requires a 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising SMA200, together with dip conditions such as RSI and MFI below thresholds or close under a lower Bollinger band offset. Exit signals fire when RSI is high and close has been above the upper Bollinger band for six consecutive candles. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI steps down from 3.5% to 0%.

families.name: NFIX_BB_RPB
families.idea_html: NFIX_BB_RPB: Operates on a 5m timeframe. The visible entry code only builds dynamic buy protections around configured EMA and SMA checks; the core buy trigger is truncated. The sell-trend function returns False, with stoploss -0.99, trailing stop disabled, and minimal ROI 100 at time 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This is a 5m strategy with parameterized buy conditions and protection filters. The visible entry code loops over buy_protection_params, checking filters such as EMA200 alignment and rising SMA200, but the actual buy trigger is not shown. Sell signals are disabled in populate_sell_trend, and exits rely on custom_sell and custom_stoploss hooks with minimal_roi 100.0 and stoploss -0.99.

This is a 5m strategy with parameterized buy conditions and protection filters. The visible entry code loops over buy_protection_params, checking filters such as EMA200 alignment and rising SMA200, but the actual buy trigger is not shown. Sell signals are set to 0 in populate_sell_trend, and exits rely on custom_sell and custom_stoploss hooks with minimal_roi 100.0 and stoploss -0.99.

families.name: NNTC_profit_LSTM
families.idea_html: NNTC_profit_LSTM: The fact sheet contains only the class attributes header and empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No timeframe, entry trigger, exit rule, or other trading logic is provided. Thus the strategy cannot be classified beyond other.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet contains only the class attributes header and empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No timeframe, entry trigger, exit rule, or other trading logic is provided. Thus the strategy cannot be classified beyond other.

families.idea_html: NNTC_profit_Wavenet: The fact sheet contains no indicator code, entry code, or exit code. The trading logic, timeframe, and exits cannot be determined from the provided sheet.

families.name: OBOnly
families.idea_html: OBOnly: On 1-hour candles every processed candle is marked as a buy and no sell signal is generated, so trade gating is left to the confirm_trade_entry hook. Exits therefore rely on the -0.01 stoploss or the very short minimal ROI ladder that starts at 0.01 and decays to 0.002 after 25 minutes.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles the entry is a random draw (random.randint(0, 2) == 0) combined with a per-pair condition flag; that flag is set from EMA12 above EMA26 and close above EMA12 only when protections are enabled. No sell signal is emitted, so exits rely on the -0.02 stoploss or the custom_sell hook. Candles are processed even when not new.

OBOnlyV4 runs on a 5m timeframe with a tight -0.006 stoploss. It computes a two-candle range ratio and, when the relative range is below 0.06, enables a random buy entry based on a performance weight. There is no sell signal; exits are handled elsewhere.

families.name: Obelisk
families.idea_html: Obelisk: Obelisk is a 5m strategy that uses a slow informative timeframe to compute Ichimoku and ZEMA indicators. It buys when the Ichimoku filter is valid, the market is not bear-trending, and close is below the ZEMA multiplied by a low offset. It exits when close is above the ZEMA multiplied by a high offset, with a -0.294 stoploss and a multi-step ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Obelisk Ichimoku ZEMA v1 runs on 5m with a slow informative timeframe for Ichimoku and ZEMA. It buys when the Ichimoku filter is valid, the market is not bear-trending, and close is below the ZEMA multiplied by a low offset. It exits when close is above the ZEMA multiplied by a high offset, with a -0.294 stoploss and tiered ROI.

Obelisk Ichimoku ZEMA v1_555 runs on 5m with a slow informative timeframe for Ichimoku and ZEMA. It enters when the Ichimoku filter is valid, the market is not bear-trending, and close crosses above the ZEMA multiplied by a low offset. It exits when close crosses above the ZEMA multiplied by a high offset, with a -0.294 stoploss and tiered ROI.

families.name: Patterns
families.idea_html: Patterns: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when RSI is below a limit, close is below SMA, MFI is at or below a limit, and an enabled bullish candlestick pattern meets the pattern strength. It exits when enabled bearish candlestick patterns meet the pattern strength, unless sell-hold is enabled. It has no stoploss or minimal ROI shown in the class attributes.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy enters when candlestick patterns such as morning star, hammer, or three white soldiers meet a pattern-strength threshold, together with optional mean-reversion conditions like RSI oversold, close below a 40-period SMA, MFI oversold, or a Bollinger-band gain threshold. It uses the configured timeframe and its exit signal sets sell to 0, so positions are closed by the configured ROI, stoploss, or trailing stop. A startup candle count of 20 is used.

This strategy enters when candlestick patterns such as morning star, hammer, or three white soldiers meet a pattern-strength threshold, together with optional mean-reversion conditions like RSI oversold, close below a 40-period SMA, MFI oversold, or a Bollinger-band gain threshold. It uses the configured timeframe and its exit signal sets sell to 0, so positions are closed by the configured ROI, stoploss, or trailing stop. A startup candle count of 20 is used.

families.name: Pmax
families.idea_html: Pmax: This 5-minute strategy uses ZLEMA and PMAX indicators. It enters long when ZLEMA crosses above the PMAX line and exits when ZLEMA crosses below it. The stoploss is set to -1, which disables it, and there are no additional hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This daily strategy enters long when ZLEMA crosses above the PMAX line and the Fibonacci retracement value is below 0.5. Heikin-Ashi and Fibonacci indicators are computed, and a custom stoploss hook is present. Exit signals and ROI are disabled, while stoploss is -1 and trailing stop is false.

This daily strategy enters long when ZLEMA crosses above the PMAX line and the Fibonacci retracement value is below 0.5. Heikin-Ashi and Fibonacci indicators are computed, and a custom stoploss hook is present. Exit signals and ROI are disabled, while stoploss is -1 and trailing stop is false.

families.name: RSIDivergence
families.idea_html: RSIDivergence_2: On the 15m timeframe this strategy buys on RSI-divergence conditions (regular bullish or hidden bullish) that must coincide with the EWO printing above its rolling-window maximum while RSI stays below a configurable cap; an optional branch trades a cross of RSI above its smoothed SMMA with a low-RSI filter. It exits when EWO sits above a floor but is lower than the previous bar. Trade management adds a trailing stop, a custom stoploss hook and an informative higher-timeframe SAR.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe this strategy buys when a bullish or hidden-bullish RSI divergence is detected and RSI, ADX and stochastic slowk all sit inside configurable ranges around the pivot oscillator value. The trade ends on a bearish or hidden-bearish divergence signal. It uses a 5% ROI target, a -8% stoploss and a trailing stop.

On the 5m timeframe this strategy buys purely when a regular bullish or hidden-bullish RSI divergence condition is detected, with volume above zero as the only other requirement. It exits when a bearish or hidden-bearish divergence appears. Position sizing risk is capped by a -5% stoploss, a trailing stop and a 5% ROI target.

families.name: Roth
families.idea_html: Roth01: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when MFI is below 24, price is below the lower Bollinger band, and CCI is at or below -57. It exits when SAR is above price, RSI is above 75, price is above the upper Bollinger band, CCI is at least 83, and MFI is below 92. It uses a stepped minimal ROI and a -0.29585 stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when price is below the lower Bollinger band, fastd is above 18, and MFI is below 22. It exits when ADX is above 52, RSI is above 97, CCI is at least 50, MFI is above 93, fastd is above 70, and price is above the upper Bollinger band. It uses a stepped minimal ROI and a -0.21179 stoploss.

On the 5m timeframe, it buys when price is below the lower Bollinger band, fastd is above 37, and MFI is below 20. It exits when SAR is above price, RSI is above 69, MFI is above 86, and fastd is above 79. It uses a stepped minimal ROI and a -0.31939 stoploss.

families.name: Stavix
families.idea_html: Stavix: On a 1m timeframe, this strategy enters when the 6h ROCR is above 0.60 and either price dips below a shifted lower Bollinger band with specific tail and delta conditions, or price is below the slow EMA and 0.985 of the lower Bollinger band with low volume. It exits when close rises above the middle Bollinger band. The stoploss is -0.01 and minimal ROI is 0.15.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Uses an Ichimoku cloud with custom periods. It enters when the close is above both senkou span A and B and the kijun sen crosses above the tenkan sen. It exits when the close is below both senkou spans and the tenkan sen crosses above the kijun sen. Minimal ROI is 15% and stoploss is -10%.

Builds a SuperTrend indicator from ATR bands on the 15m timeframe. It enters when the average price crosses above the SuperTrend and volume is positive, and exits when the SuperTrend crosses above the average price. It uses trailing stop and a -31% stoploss.

families.name: Stinkfist
families.idea_html: Stinkfist: On 5m timeframe, uses RMI, MAC, streak, PCC, ROC, daily high/low and ADR. For new trades it buys when close is near the 3-day low plus a fraction of ADR, MP is below a threshold, streak ROC is above the PCC lower band, and MAC condition holds. Exit logic uses RMI downtrend, loss cutoff, and RMI thresholds; active trades can be added when RMI is in an uptrend.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet only shows class attributes on the 5m timeframe and use_sell_signal set to False. No indicator, entry, or exit code is provided. Therefore no trading logic can be identified.

The fact sheet only shows class attributes on the 5m timeframe with trailing_stop enabled and use_sell_signal set to False. No indicator, entry, or exit code is provided. Therefore no trading logic can be identified.

families.name: StrategyScalpingFast
families.idea_html: StrategyScalpingFast: This 1m strategy buys when open is below the EMA low while ADX is above 30, MFI is below 30, fast Stochastic is below 30 with a fastk/fastd cross, and CCI is below -150. An exit signal is defined for open at/above EMA high or Stochastic crossing above 70 with CCI above 150, but use_sell_signal is False. It relies on a 1% minimal ROI and a -50% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This 1m strategy buys when open is below EMA low and the resampled higher-timeframe SMA is below close, with optional ADX, MFI, and fast Stochastic filters plus a fastk/fastd cross when both Stochastic filters are enabled. An exit signal is defined for open at/above EMA high and optional Stochastic, CCI, MFI, or ADX thresholds, but use_sell_signal is False. It uses a tiered minimal ROI starting at 8.2% and a -32.6% stoploss.

This 1m strategy buys when open is below EMA low and the resampled higher-timeframe SMA is below close, with optional ADX, MFI, and fast Stochastic entry filters plus a fastk/fastd cross when both Stochastic filters are enabled. An exit signal is defined for open at/above EMA high and optional Stochastic, CCI, MFI, or ADX thresholds, but use_exit_signal is False. It uses a tiered minimal ROI starting at 8.2% and a -32.6% stoploss.

families.name: Swing_High_To_Sky
families.idea_html: Swing_High_To_Sky: A 15m strategy that computes two CCI periods and two RSI periods. It buys when the buy-period CCI is below its threshold and the buy-period RSI is below its threshold, i.e. on oversold readings, and sells when the sell-period CCI and RSI are both above their thresholds. Stoploss is -0.34338 and the ROI table steps from 27% down to 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy computes MACD plus a buy-period and a sell-period CCI. It buys when MACD is above its signal line and the buy CCI is at or below -100, and sells when MACD is below its signal line and the sell CCI is at or above 200. The ROI table is inactive, the stoploss is -0.30 and a trailing stop is enabled.

On a 5m timeframe, the strategy buys when both CCI and RSI are below their configured buy thresholds, and sells when both CCI and RSI are above their configured sell thresholds. It uses a stoploss of -0.34338 and a stepwise minimal ROI schedule.

families.name: TA_Collector
families.idea_html: TA_Collector_v1: On a 1m timeframe, this strategy sets both buy and sell signals to zero, so it generates no entries or exits. It merges 1h and 5m informative data and posts the latest row to an external data gateway. It has a stoploss of -0.99 and a stepwise minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1m timeframe, this strategy sets both buy and sell signals to zero, so it generates no entries or exits. It merges 1h and 5m informative data and posts the latest row to an external data gateway. It has a stoploss of -0.99 and a stepwise minimal ROI.

On a 1m timeframe, this strategy sets both buy and sell signals to zero, so it generates no entries or exits. It merges 1h and 5m informative data and posts the latest row to an external data gateway. It has a stoploss of -0.99 and a stepwise minimal ROI.

families.name: TDSequentialStrategy
families.idea_html: TDSequentialStrategy: On a 1h timeframe, this strategy counts consecutive lower closes in a TD Sequential style and buys when the buy count exceeds 8 together with an exceed-low condition. It exits on an exceed-high or a sell sequence above 8. It uses a stoploss of -0.05 and a minimal ROI of 5.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 15m timeframe, the strategy combines TD Sequential-style exceed-low and buy-sequence conditions with RSI above 10 and a close below the lower Bollinger band to enter long. It exits on exceed-high or sell-sequence conditions together with RSI above 90 and a close above the upper Bollinger band. It uses a stoploss of -0.1 and a minimal ROI of 5.

On a 5m timeframe, the strategy uses TD Sequential-style counts of consecutive lower closes and buys when the count exceeds 8 with an exceed-low condition. It exits on an exceed-high or a sell sequence above 8. It uses a stoploss of -0.05 and a stepwise minimal ROI.

families.name: TemaMaster
families.idea_html: TemaMaster: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when TEMA crosses above the lower Bollinger band while CMO is above -5. There is no sell signal in the code; trades are closed by ROI or the trailing stop. Stoploss is set and trailing stop is enabled.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1m, it enters long when TEMA crosses above the lower Bollinger band and CMO is above -3. It exits when CMO crosses below -22 or below 25. Uses trailing stop and ROI.

On 1m candles, it enters long when TEMA crosses above the lower Bollinger band and CMO is above 0. It exits when CMO crosses below -17 or below 23. It uses a -0.11746 stoploss, trailing stop, and a minimal ROI ladder.

families.name: TemaPure
families.idea_html: TemaPure: On 5m, it buys when TEMA is at or below a lower Bollinger band and CMO crosses above zero. It exits when TEMA crosses above an upper Bollinger band. Uses trailing stop and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it buys when TEMA crosses above the lower Bollinger band while CMO is above -5. It exits when CMO crosses below -58. Uses trailing stop and ROI.
On 5m, it buys when TEMA crosses above the lower Bollinger band with 1 standard deviation and CMO is above zero. It exits when CMO crosses below -25. Uses trailing stop and ROI.

families.name: TheForce
families.idea_html: TheForce: On 15m, it buys when fast stochastic is between 20 and 80, MACD and its signal line are both rising, close is above the previous close, and EMA of close is at or above EMA of open. It exits on the opposite MACD and EMA conditions while the stochastic is not above 80. Uses stoploss and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles, it enters long when Stochastic slow %K and %D are between 20 and 80 and MACD and its signal line are rising, close is above the previous close, and either EMA5 close is at or above EMA5 open or open is below EMA5 low; the entry code also shows a partial Bollinger lower-band branch. Exits use falling MACD and signal conditions. It has a -10% stoploss, no trailing stop, and minimal ROI targets.

On 5-minute candles, it enters long when Stochastic is either neutral (slow %K and %D between 20 and 80) or oversold (both below 30 with %K crossing above %D), while MACD and its signal line are rising and close is above the previous close. Exits use Stochastic and MACD reversal conditions. It has a -10% stoploss, no trailing stop, and a minimal ROI of 10.

families.name: TrailingBuyStrat
families.idea_html: TrailingBuyStrat: This is a trailing-buy wrapper around a base strategy. It initializes trailing-buy state and, when a base pre-buy signal appears, starts a trailing buy order; in live or dry-run it manages that order. The actual entry logic comes from the superclass and is not shown in the fact sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This is a trailing-buy wrapper that calls the base strategy's buy logic. In live or dry-run it starts a trailing buy when the base buy signal appears and can force a buy while trailing is active. The actual entry signal comes from the superclass and is not shown.
The fact sheet contains no indicator, entry, or exit code. No trading logic is available to describe.

families.name: TrendFollowingStrategy
families.idea_html: TrendFollowingStrategy: On a 5m timeframe it computes a 20-period exponential mean of close and OBV. It enters long when close crosses above that trend line while OBV rises, and enters short when close crosses below it while OBV falls. Exits occur on the opposite crossover, and a trailing stop, -0.265 stoploss, and custom_exit/leverage hooks are configured.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys when close is above EMA14, EMA14 is above EMA28, RSI is above its buy threshold, and Williams %R is below its buy threshold. It sells when close is below EMA14, EMA14 is below EMA28, RSI is below its sell threshold, and Williams %R is above its sell threshold. It uses a -0.1 stoploss and trailing stop with stepped minimal ROI.

On 5m candles, it enters long when close crosses above a 20-period EMA while OBV rises and RSI is below 30; it enters short when close crosses below the EMA while OBV falls and RSI is above 70. Exits occur on the opposite trend cross with opposing OBV direction. It can short, uses a -0.2 stoploss, and has trailing stop with ROI steps.

families.name: bbandrsi
families.idea_html: bbandrsi: On 15m timeframe, buys when RSI is below 30 and price closes below the lower Bollinger band, and sells when RSI is above 70. It uses a -0.25 stoploss and minimal_roi.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m timeframe, buys when RSI is below 30 and price closes below the lower Bollinger band, and sells when RSI is above 70. It uses a -0.1 stoploss and minimal_roi.

On 1h timeframe, buys when RSI is below 28 and price closes below the 3-standard-deviation lower Bollinger band, and sells when RSI is above 92 and price is above the 1-standard-deviation lower Bollinger band. It uses a -0.426344266835836 stoploss and minimal_roi.

families.name: cryptotank
families.idea_html: cryptotank: On 1h timeframe, it enters long when the rolling minimum of the smoothed slope of the percentage distance from a reference SMA is below a buy threshold. It exits when the rolling maximum of that same slope exceeds a sell threshold. It uses trailing stop, stoploss -0.25, minimal_roi 0.10, and position adjustment/custom stoploss hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m timeframe, it has multiple long entries: one when the change measure crosses above its smoothed version with positive slope and positive RSI-MA slope, and others when RSI is below a dip level and price is below the reference MA. Exits occur when the smoothed EMA filter crosses below pivot resistance levels r5, r3, or r2.75, sometimes with price above the sell offset. It uses trailing stop, stoploss -0.25, minimal_roi 0.10, and position adjustment/custom stoploss hooks.

On 15m timeframe, it enters long on dip conditions such as the change measure crossing above a buy offset while price is below the reference MA, or a rolling minimum falling below buy_offset1. Exits occur when the smoothed EMA filter crosses below pivot resistance levels r5, r3, or r2.75, with some conditions on sell offset and slope. It uses trailing stop, stoploss -0.25, minimal_roi 0.10, and position adjustment/custom stoploss hooks.

families.name: el_rsiqui
families.idea_html: el_rsiqui: This 5-minute strategy enters long when RSI is below 30 and its 60-period gradient crosses above zero, and enters short when RSI is above 70 and the gradient crosses below zero. Longs exit when RSI is above 60 and the gradient crosses below zero; shorts exit when RSI is below 40 and the gradient crosses above zero. It uses a -0.05 stoploss and no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This 5-minute strategy uses RSI and a 60-period gradient of RSI. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and the gradient crosses above zero, and enters short when RSI is above 70 and the gradient crosses below zero. Longs exit when RSI is above 60 and the gradient crosses below zero; shorts exit when RSI is below 40 and the gradient crosses above zero.

This 5-minute strategy uses RSI and its one-period difference as the gradient. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and the gradient crosses above zero, and enters short when RSI is above 70 and the gradient crosses below zero. Longs exit when RSI is above 60 and the gradient crosses below zero; shorts exit when RSI is below 40 and the gradient crosses above zero.

families.name: ema
families.idea_html: ema: This 5-minute strategy computes a composite EMA-difference oscillator and its 29-period SMA signal line. It buys when the oscillator crosses above the signal and sells when it crosses below. It has a stoploss of -1, a minimal ROI of 10, and no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when the close crosses above the lower Bollinger Band and the RSI crosses above its own lower Bollinger Band. It exits long when the close crosses below the upper Bollinger Band and the RSI crosses below its own upper Bollinger Band. It has a -10% stoploss and trailing stop enabled.

On a 4-hour timeframe, it enters long when EMA9 crosses above EMA18 and enters short when EMA9 crosses below EMA18. It exits long on the opposite EMA cross and exits short on the opposite EMA cross. It uses a -3.5% stoploss and a trailing stop.

families.name: ichiV1_Marius
families.idea_html: IchiV1_Marius_fixed_2: On a 5m timeframe, it first applies a BTC safety and anti-pump protection gate. When Tesla conditions are enabled, it enters long when multiple higher-timeframe trend closes and opens align upward, price is above EMA55, EMA21 is above a 4h trend close, RSI is above its 1h counterpart, MFI is below 70, and fan magnitude conditions are met. It has a sell signal crossing below a trend indicator but use_sell_signal is false, with custom stoploss/sell and position adjustment hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it enters when a multi-timeframe trend setup aligns, including short-term RSI above 1h RSI, multiple trend_close/trend_open comparisons, close above EMA55, EMA21 above 4h close, MFI below 70, and fan magnitude conditions. The entry is gated by BTC safety, anti-pump, buy_ok, and volume filters. It uses position adjustment and custom stoploss/sell hooks, with a sell condition crossing below a configurable trend indicator.

On the 5m timeframe, it enters when a multi-timeframe trend setup aligns, including short-term RSI above 1h RSI, multiple trend_close/trend_open comparisons, close above EMA55, EMA21 above 4h close, MFI below 70, and fan magnitude conditions. The entry is gated by BTC safety, anti-pump, buy_ok, and volume filters. It uses position adjustment and custom stoploss/sell hooks, with a sell condition crossing below a configurable trend indicator.

families.name: ichimoku
families.idea_html: ichimoku: It buys when Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen while the Ichimoku cloud is red. There is no sell signal in the exit code, so trades exit via minimal ROI or the -0.05 stoploss. No timeframe is specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It requires a minimum amount of history and then buys when MACD is above its signal on the current, 4h, and 1d timeframes, Parabolic SAR is below the open on current and 1d, RSI is below 75, and price is above an Ichimoku span. In live/dry modes it also blocks entries when the bid/ask spread is above 0.20%. The sell signal is when 1d Parabolic SAR is above the open.

On the 15m timeframe, it buys when Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen while the Ichimoku cloud is red. The sell rule is empty, so exits come from minimal ROI, stoploss, or trailing stop. It uses a trailing stop and a stoploss of -0.1.

families.name: informative_decorator_strategy
families.idea_html: informative_decorator_strategy: On a 5m timeframe, it sets RSI placeholders and merges a NEO/USDT 5m informative dataframe. The entry and exit functions just set buy and sell to zero, so there is no active trade signal. It has a -0.10 stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it sets RSI placeholders and merges a NEO/USDT 5m informative dataframe using an extra empty timeframe argument. The entry and exit functions set buy and sell to zero, so no trade signal is produced. It has a -0.10 stoploss.

On a 5m timeframe, it sets RSI placeholders and merges a BTC/USDT 5m informative dataframe. The entry and exit functions set buy and sell to zero, so no active trade signal is produced. It has a -0.10 stoploss.

families.name: kac_index
families.idea_html: kac_index_v1: On a 1h timeframe, it normalizes OHLC by a rolling TOTAL3 mean, then computes percentage ATR and CCI. It enters long when ATR is above 1.5, ATR is rising, and CCI is below 0; it exits long when ATR is below -2 and falling and CCI is above 200 and rising. Position adjustment is enabled, with a -0.9 stoploss and trailing stop disabled.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1h timeframe, it normalizes OHLC by a rolling TOTAL3 mean and computes percentage ATR and CCI. It enters long when ATR is above 2.75; it exits long when ATR is falling and CCI is rising. Position adjustment is enabled, with a -0.40 stoploss and trailing stop disabled.

On a 1h timeframe, it normalizes OHLC by a rolling TOTAL3 mean and computes percentage ATR and CCI. It enters long when ATR is above 2.75 and exits when ATR is falling and CCI is rising. Position adjustment is enabled, leverage hook is present, stoploss is -0.4, and trailing stop is disabled.

families.name: keltnerhopt
families.idea_html: keltnerhopt: On a 1d timeframe, it computes Keltner channels across hyperopt ranges for window and ATR multiplier, plus RSI(14). It enters long when close crosses above the selected Keltner upper band and RSI is above the selected buy hline; it exits when close crosses below the selected Keltner middle band. It uses a -100 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 100.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 1d timeframe, this strategy buys when the close crosses above the Keltner channel upper band while RSI is above a configured buy threshold. It exits when the close crosses below the Keltner channel middle band. It uses a -25.4% stoploss and a stepwise minimal ROI table.

On the 6h timeframe, this strategy buys when the close crosses above the Keltner channel upper band and RSI is above a configured buy threshold. It exits when the close crosses below the Keltner channel middle band. It uses a -25.4% stoploss and a minimal ROI of 1 at time zero.

families.name: piravlos
families.idea_html: piravlos0: On the 1-minute timeframe, this strategy computes Heikin-Ashi candles, EMAs, RSI, Stochastic, ADX, CTI, and Bollinger Bands. It enters long on lambo dip signals when close is below an EMA factor and short-term and medium-term RSI are below limits, with additional conditions starting from a local uptrend block. Exits use Fisher and Heikin-Ashi conditions, with a trailing stop and custom stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 1-minute timeframe it buys when price falls below the 14-period EMA multiplied by a factor while RSI(4) and RSI(14) are under configured limits, gated by a BTC-safety filter and an anti-pump threshold. The long exit triggers when a Fisher reading is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes step down, price sits below a fast EMA and above the Bollinger midband. Risk handling is a very wide stoploss plus a minimal ROI ladder, with custom stoploss and informative pairs hooks.

On the 1-minute timeframe it buys when price falls below the 14-period EMA times a factor while RSI(4) and RSI(14) are under configured limits, filtered by BTC safety and an anti-pump threshold. The long exit triggers when a Fisher value is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes step down, price is below a fast EMA and above the Bollinger midband. It uses a -8.5% stoploss with a minimal ROI ladder, and custom stoploss and informative pairs hooks.

families.name: smart_money_strategy
families.idea_html: smart_money_strategy: On the 1-hour timeframe it buys when price is below the 200-period EMA with MFI below 35 and Chaikin Money Flow below -0.07, i.e. weakness combined with weak money flow. It sells when price is above the EMA200 with MFI above 70 and CMF above 0.20. The minimal ROI is 10 and the stoploss is -99%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it computes the Smart Money Index and its moving averages plus a 1h EMA50. It enters long when the Smart Money Index crosses above a fast or slow moving average, volume is positive, the 1h SMI trend is not 2, and price is below the 1h EMA50. It exits on a smart-money cross below its sell MA when the 1h SMI trend is 2, with use_exit_signal enabled and stoploss -0.99.

On 1h, it buys when close is below the 200-period EMA, MFI is below a buy threshold, and Chaikin Money Flow is below a buy threshold. It sells when close is above the 200-period EMA, MFI is above a sell threshold, and CMF is above a sell threshold. Stoploss is -99 and minimal ROI is set.

families.name: ADXDM
families.idea_html: ADXDM: This strategy uses ADX and directional movement indicators. It enters long when ADX is above a threshold, the ADX slope crosses below zero, and minus DM exceeds plus DM (dm_delta < 0), a contrarian buy after bearish trend momentum. It exits when ADX is above the threshold, the ADX slope crosses below zero, and plus DM exceeds minus DM, with an optional Bollinger gain condition. Stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and timeframe are taken from configuration.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy uses ADX and directional movement indicators. It enters long when ADX is above a threshold, the ADX slope crosses below zero, and minus DM exceeds plus DM (dm_delta < 0), a contrarian buy after bearish trend momentum. It exits when ADX is above the threshold, the ADX slope crosses below zero, and plus DM exceeds minus DM, with an optional Bollinger gain condition. Stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and timeframe are taken from configuration.

families.name: ADX_15M_USDT
families.idea_html: ADX_15M_USDT: This strategy uses ADX and DI indicators. It enters long when ADX > 16, minus DI > 4, plus DI > 20, and plus DI crosses above minus DI. It exits when ADX > 43, minus DI > 22, plus DI > 20, and minus DI crosses above plus DI. It uses a layered minimal ROI and a stoploss of -0.1255.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy enters long whenever minus DI crosses above plus DI, a bearish directional movement crossover, without an ADX filter in the entry. It exits when ADX > 91, minus DI > 91, and plus DI crosses above minus DI. It uses a layered minimal ROI and a stoploss of -0.31941.

families.name: ARIMA
families.idea_html: ARIMA_15: This strategy trains an ARIMA model on OHLC4 to produce a decision signal and uses it in entry and exit rules. It enters long when the decision is 1 and several conditions align, including move above its mean, OHLC4 below a falling sma_dn, and positive volume. It exits when the decision is -1 and the opposite conditions appear. It runs on a 15m timeframe with custom entry price and custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss, and layered ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy inherits the base indicator and entry logic and adds trailing-buy order management. In live or dry-run mode, when the inherited entry signal appears it can start a trailing buy, and if a trailing buy is already started it forces a long entry signal and updates the enter tag. No exit code is shown in the fact sheet.

families.name: AdvancedMultiIndicatorStrategy
families.idea_html: AdvancedMultiIndicatorStrategy: On 5-minute candles, the long entry requires oversold RSI and stochastic, price below the lower Bollinger band, a bullish MACD condition, price above EMA20, ADX above 25, MFI below 20, and ATR expansion above 1.5 times its 14-period mean. The sell signal requires overbought RSI and stochastic, price above the upper band, bearish MACD, ADX above 25, MFI above 80, and ATR below its 14-period mean. It uses a minimal ROI table and an 8% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles with shorting enabled, it enters long on oversold RSI and stochastic, price below the lower Bollinger band, bullish MACD, price above EMA20, ADX above 25, MFI below 20, and ATR expansion. It enters short on overbought RSI and stochastic, price above the upper band, bearish MACD, ADX above 25, MFI above 80, and ATR below its 14-period mean. Exits mirror the opposite side, and the class uses a minimal ROI table, an 8% stoploss, and a leverage hook.

families.name: Advanced_Ichimoku
families.idea_html: Advanced_Ichimoku: On a 5-minute timeframe, it computes SMA15, CTI, RSI fast/slow, stochastic, and CCI. It enters long when the slow RSI is falling, fast RSI is below a threshold, RSI is above another threshold, price is below SMA15 times a factor, and CTI is below a threshold. The exit signal is empty; a custom_exit hook is present, with a 100% minimal ROI and 27% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles, it computes Heikin-Ashi prices and multiple EMA-based higher-timeframe trend closes, then uses Ichimoku Senkou spans. The long entry requires the configured number of trend closes to be above both Senkou A and Senkou B across timeframes. The exit signal sells when the 5-minute trend close crosses below the chosen sell trend indicator; it uses leverage and a minimal ROI table.

families.name: AnomalyDetector
families.idea_html: AnomalyDetectorv2: 1h long-only strategy that enters when a volume z-score anomaly (>3) occurs and ATR is above its rolling mean. It exits when RSI (or backup RSI) is overbought. Trailing stop and a very wide stoploss are configured.

other_descriptions.idea_html: 1h long-only strategy that enters when a volume z-score anomaly (>3) occurs and ATR is above its rolling mean. It exits when RSI (or backup RSI) is overbought. Trailing stop and a very wide stoploss are configured.

families.name: AntigravityStrategy
families.idea_html: AntigravityStrategy: 1h long-only FreqAI strategy. It enters when the model score `&-s-close` exceeds the buy threshold (or RL action), do_predict is 1, the regime is not high-volatility, and volume >0. Exits on overbought Bollinger position and RSI, or on a model exit condition.

other_descriptions.idea_html: FreqAI-based 1h long strategy. Enters when the FreqAI long signal or ML score exceeds the buy threshold with do_predict==1, regime not high-volatility and volume>0. Exits on ML bearish signal or when BB position and RSI are above the sell thresholds; uses trailing stop and -3% stoploss.

families.name: Aquma
families.idea_html: Aquma1: 15m long/short strategy using a model probability plus indicator filters. Long entry requires pred_prob > 0.55, RSI < 40, close > EMA20 and ADX > 20; short entry requires pred_prob < 0.45, RSI > 60, close < EMA20 and ADX > 20. Exits when pred_prob crosses 0.5 or RSI reaches the opposite threshold; stoploss -2% and ROI ladder.

other_descriptions.idea_html: 1h long/short strategy using smoothed Heikin-Ashi, cumulative delta volume, and STC. Long when current and previous SHA are green, CDV is above its 50 SMA, and STC is green; short on the red equivalents. Exits when STC color flips; uses trailing stop and -5% stoploss.

families.name: Auto_EI_t4c0s
families.idea_html: Auto_EI_t4c0s: 5m long strategy using EWO levels. Entries when EWO is below down-fib/mean/zero thresholds with buy_decision and gen_buy filters, or above the up-fib with those filters, and volume>0. Exits when EWO is below down thresholds with sell_decision and gen_sell; custom stoploss and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: 5m short strategy using EWO levels. Entries when EWO is below down-fib/mean/zero thresholds with sell_decision and gen_sell filters, or above the up-fib with those filters, and volume>0. Exits when EWO is below down thresholds with buy_decision and gen_buy; custom stoploss and ROI.

families.name: AwesomeStrategy
families.idea_html: AwesomeStrategy: On a 5m timeframe with an informative timeframe, this strategy enters long on mean-reversion conditions, including price below Smooth_HA_L and higher-timeframe EMA bearishness, with branches using oversold MFI, DMI minus above 30, SAR, oversold stochastic RSI, fastd, and MFI below 30. It exits when price is above Smooth_HA_H and higher-timeframe EMA is bullish, with bandwidth expansion and overbought MFI or DMI plus VFI above zero. It uses custom_stoploss, trailing stop, and a decaying minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1-minute timeframe, it enters long when the 1-period ROC falls to or below the negative BUY_ROC threshold, and enters short when ROC rises to or above SELL_ROC. There is no exit signal logic; trades use a -29.4% stoploss and trailing stop. The strategy can short and uses informative-pairs and leverage hooks.

families.name: BBRSIS
families.idea_html: BBRSIS: It enters long when close is below the lower Bollinger band, SMA5 is at or above SMA75, SMA75 is at or above SMA200, current RSI is at least 5 below the 3x resampled RSI, and volume is positive. It exits when close is above the middle Bollinger band and current RSI is above the 3x resampled RSI by 5 and above the 6x and 10x resampled RSIs. It uses a 30% minimal ROI and -99% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Buys when close is below the Bollinger lower band, SMA5 is at or above SMA75, SMA75 is at or above SMA200, and the current RSI is more than 5 below the 3x resampled RSI. It exits when close is above the Bollinger middle band and RSI is above the 3x, 6x, and 10x resampled RSI values. The sheet shows a 0.30 minimal ROI and a -0.99 stoploss; no timeframe is given.

families.name: BB_RPB_3c
families.idea_html: BB_RPB_3c: The 5-minute strategy combines several buy tags: one buys when price is below EMA8 and stochastic crosses up from low levels with ADX and EWO above thresholds; another buys when Heikin-Ashi close is below a shifted lower Bollinger band with tail and closedelta conditions; a third uses EWO low and higher-timeframe Bollinger middleband checks. The sell signal closes when price is above SMA9 with MA/RSI conditions, or on a rising SMA9 with price below HMA50 and above an MA offset. It uses minimal ROI 0.10, stoploss -0.99, and a custom_stoploss hook.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The 5-minute strategy uses multi-tag entries: price below EMA8 with stochastic cross from low levels plus ADX/EWO filters, Heikin-Ashi close below a shifted lower Bollinger band with tail and closedelta conditions, and an EWO-low/higher-timeframe Bollinger condition. The sell signal closes when price is above SMA9 with MA/RSI conditions, or on a rising SMA9 with price below HMA50 and above an MA offset. It sets minimal ROI 0.10 and stoploss -1, with a custom_stoploss hook present.

families.name: BTCBigDrop
families.idea_html: BTCBigDrop: On the configured timeframe, it buys when BTC 5m price has dropped by a configured fraction over a set number of candles, optionally requiring MFI below a level, Fisher RSI below a level, or close below the lower weighted Bollinger band. The exit signal is disabled, so trades close via ROI, stoploss, or trailing stop from the config. It merges a 5m informative pair and uses multiple oscillators and moving averages.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, it buys when BTC 5m price has dropped by a configured fraction over a set number of candles, optionally requiring MFI below a level, Fisher RSI below a level, or close below the lower weighted Bollinger band. The exit signal is disabled, so trades close via ROI, stoploss, or trailing stop from the config. It merges a 5m informative pair and uses multiple oscillators and moving averages.

families.name: BTCEMABounce
families.idea_html: BTCEMABounce: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when the BTC 5m short-EMA angle crosses above zero and the EMA-difference condition is positive, with volume above zero. It optionally requires the BTC MACD histogram to be non-negative. It exits when the EMA angle crosses below zero, with close above the EMA and the EMA-difference condition above a sell threshold, unless sell-hold disables the exit.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when the BTC 5m short-EMA angle crosses above zero and the EMA-difference condition is positive, with volume above zero. It optionally requires the BTC MACD histogram to be non-negative. It exits when the EMA angle crosses below zero, with close above the EMA and the EMA-difference condition above a sell threshold, unless sell-hold disables the exit.

families.name: BTCMACDCross
families.idea_html: BTCMACDCross: On the configured timeframe, it buys when the BTC 5m MACD crosses above its signal while volume is above zero. Optional filters can require ADX above a level, positive DM delta, MFI above a level, close below SAR, Fisher RSI below a level, negative MACD, or a minimum BB gain. It exits when the local MACD crosses below its signal, optionally requiring MACD to be positive, unless sell-hold disables the exit.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, it buys when the BTC 5m MACD crosses above its signal while volume is above zero. Optional filters can require ADX above a level, positive DM delta, MFI above a level, close below SAR, Fisher RSI below a level, negative MACD, or a minimum BB gain. It exits when the local MACD crosses below its signal, optionally requiring MACD to be positive, unless sell-hold disables the exit.

families.name: BTCNDrop
families.idea_html: BTCNDrop: The strategy works on a configured timeframe and merges 5m BTC informative data. It buys when optional MFI and Fisher-RSI oversold filters, a close at or below the lower Bollinger band, prior bearish 5m candles, and a configured drop condition are all true. The exit signal is always zero, so exits are managed by the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop settings.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy works on a configured timeframe and merges 5m BTC informative data. It buys when optional MFI and Fisher-RSI oversold filters, a close at or below the lower Bollinger band, prior bearish 5m candles, and a configured drop condition are all true. The exit signal is always zero, so exits are managed by the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop settings.

families.name: BTCNSeq
families.idea_html: BTCNSeq: It operates on a configured timeframe and merges 5m BTC informative data. It buys after a drop when optional Fisher-RSI is at or below a threshold, the close is sufficiently below the upper Bollinger band, the current 5m candle is green, previous 5m candles are bearish, and the configured drop percentage is met. Exit signals are disabled, leaving exits to the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop settings.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It operates on a configured timeframe and merges 5m BTC informative data. It buys after a drop when optional Fisher-RSI is at or below a threshold, the close is sufficiently below the upper Bollinger band, the current 5m candle is green, previous 5m candles are bearish, and the configured drop percentage is met. Exit signals are disabled, leaving exits to the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop settings.

families.name: Bandtastic
families.idea_html: Bandtastic: It runs on a 15m timeframe and uses RSI, MFI, fast/slow EMAs, and Bollinger bands of 1 to 4 standard deviations. The buy trigger is when price closes below a selected lower Bollinger band, optionally with oversold RSI/MFI and a fast EMA above slow EMA; the sell side mirrors this with overbought RSI/MFI, EMA reversal, or a close above a selected upper Bollinger band. It uses configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It runs on a 15m timeframe and uses RSI, MFI, and Bollinger bands of 1 to 4 standard deviations. The entry trigger is a close below a selected lower Bollinger band, optionally with oversold RSI/MFI and fast/slow EMA alignment; the exit side mirrors this with overbought RSI/MFI, EMA reversal, or a close above a selected upper Bollinger band. It uses configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop.

families.name: BcmbigzDevelop
families.idea_html: BcmbigzDevelop: The strategy is on a 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, custom sell and custom stoploss hooks, and a very wide stoploss. The provided entry code only sets many buy-condition enable flags to False and is truncated before any actual buy condition is shown. Visible sell logic exits when close is above the middle Bollinger band times 1.01 or above the upper Bollinger band on several consecutive candles, with volume greater than zero.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy is on a 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, custom sell and custom stoploss hooks, and trailing stop disabled. The provided entry code only initializes many buy-condition enable flags and is truncated before any actual buy condition is shown. Visible exit conditions sell when close is above the middle Bollinger band times 1.01 or when close is above the upper Bollinger band on consecutive candles.

families.name: BeastBotXBLR
families.idea_html: BeastBotXBLR6: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, it computes RMI, CCI, stochastic RSI, Bollinger width/delta, SSL channels, and other indicators. One entry condition buys when RMI, CCI, and stochastic RSI are low, Bollinger width/delta exceed thresholds, candle delta is positive, and price is below a lower Bollinger band; other conditions use 1h EMA trend and CTI with lower-band dips. Sell logic exits when RSI is high and price stays above the upper Bollinger band for several candles with volume.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, it computes RMI, CCI, stochastic RSI, Bollinger width/delta, SSL channels, and other indicators. One entry condition buys when RMI, CCI, and stochastic RSI are low, Bollinger width/delta exceed thresholds, candle delta is positive, and price is below a lower Bollinger band; other conditions use 1h EMA trend and CTI with lower-band dips. Sell logic exits when RSI is high and price stays above the upper Bollinger band for several candles with volume.

families.name: BigDrop
families.idea_html: BigDrop: The strategy enters long when a configurable drop over a number of candles coincides with optional filters: MFI at or below a level, Fisher RSI below a level, and/or close at or below the lower weighted Bollinger band. It sets the sell column to 0, so no sell signal is produced there; exits rely on the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop. The timeframe is taken from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy enters long when a configurable drop over a number of candles coincides with optional filters: MFI at or below a level, Fisher RSI below a level, and/or close at or below the lower weighted Bollinger band. It sets the sell column to 0, so no sell signal is produced there; exits rely on the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing stop. The timeframe is taken from Config.

families.name: BigPete
families.idea_html: BigPete: The strategy uses two buy conditions: one buys a dip where close and low are below the lower Bollinger band while price is above EMA200 and EMA200 on 1h, with volume pump/drop filters; the other buys when MACD histogram is positive and has been positive for several bars, gated by close above EMA200. The sell function sets sell to 0 for a close above the middle Bollinger band, so exits rely on custom sell/stoploss and ROI. Timeframe is 5m.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy appends two buy conditions: a dip below the lower Bollinger band with price above EMA200/EMA200 1h and volume filters, or a sustained positive MACD histogram with close above EMA200. The sell function sets sell to 0 for a close above the middle Bollinger band, so exits rely on custom sell/stoploss and ROI. Timeframe is 5m.

families.name: BigZ04HO
families.idea_html: BigZ04HO: The strategy appends two buy conditions: a dip below the lower Bollinger band with price above EMA200/EMA200 1h and volume filters, or a sustained positive MACD histogram with close above EMA200. The sell function sets sell to 0 for a close above the middle Bollinger band, so exits rely on custom sell/stoploss and ROI. Timeframe is 5m.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy appends two buy conditions: a dip below the lower Bollinger band scaled by parameters, with price above EMA200/EMA200 1h and volume filters, or a sustained positive MACD histogram with close above EMA200. The sell function sets sell to 0 for a close above the middle Bollinger band, so exits rely on custom sell/stoploss and ROI. Timeframe is 5m.

families.name: BigZ07Next
families.idea_html: BigZ07Next: The strategy enters long on oversold conditions: one buy condition requires RSI below 22 and CMF below -0.435 while close is above EMA200 1h, with volume pump/drop filters; another buys a dip below the lower Bollinger band. Exits include a sell when RSI is above a level and close remains above the upper Bollinger band for several bars. Timeframe is 5m.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy enters long on oversold conditions: one buy condition requires RSI below 22 and CMF below -0.435 while close is above EMA200 1h, with volume pump/drop filters; another buys a dip below the lower Bollinger band. Exits include a sell when RSI is above a level and close remains above the upper Bollinger band for several bars. Timeframe is 5m.

families.name: BinHV27F
families.idea_html: BinHV27F: On the 5m timeframe, it uses RSI/EMARSI, ADX, directional indicators, and SMA trend state. Entry variants buy when the fast SMA is below the slow SMA (bigdown), price is below highsma and lowsma, minus DI is above its EMA, RSI is not falling, ADX is above a parameter, and EMARSI is at or below a parameter. Exits occur when price rises above lowsma or highsma or when EMARSI reaches a threshold, with minimal ROI 0:100, stoploss -0.25, and a leverage hook.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it uses RSI/EMARSI, ADX, directional indicators, and SMA trend state. Entry variants buy when the fast SMA is below the slow SMA (bigdown), price is below highsma and lowsma, minus DI is above its EMA, RSI is not falling, ADX is above a parameter, and EMARSI is at or below a parameter. Exits occur when price rises above lowsma or highsma or when EMARSI reaches a threshold, with minimal ROI 0:100, stoploss -0.25, and a leverage hook.

families.name: BinMfiBTC
families.idea_html: BinMfiBTCv4: On 5m, it builds Bollinger Bands on hl2 and computes MFI, RSI and EWO. It buys when the BTC context flag and MFI threshold align with a lower-band dip: price closes below the shifted lower band, with band delta, close delta and tail conditions, and close not above the previous close. Sell signals are disabled (sell=0), so exits rely on custom_stoploss and the ROI/stoploss/trailing-stop settings.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it merges BTC informative data and computes Bollinger Bands on hl2 plus MFI, RSI and EWO. Entries require BTC close above SMA100 and then one of several long setups: a lower-band dip with MFI at or below a limit, an EWO-bottom condition with rising RSI, or an EWO bull condition with recent negative EWO and low 1h RSI; a separate BTC/SMA50 condition is also present. Sell signals are disabled, so exits rely on custom_stoploss and the ROI/stoploss/trailing-stop settings.

families.name: BinanceStream
families.idea_html: BinanceStream: The indicator method returns the dataframe unchanged, and entry/exit decisions come from external per-pair check_buy() and check_sell() methods. No timeframe, stoploss, or indicator logic is shown in the fact sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The indicator method returns the dataframe unchanged, and entry/exit decisions come from external per-pair check_buy() and check_sell() methods. No timeframe, stoploss, or indicator logic is shown in the fact sheet.

families.name: BinanceWS
families.idea_html: BinanceWS: The fact sheet lists only class attributes and hooks, with empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No trading logic, timeframe, stoploss, or ROI is shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet lists only class attributes and hooks, with empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No trading logic, timeframe, stoploss, or ROI is shown.

families.name: BollingerBounce
families.idea_html: BollingerBounce: On the configured timeframe, it computes MFI, Fisher RSI, weighted Bollinger Bands, EMAs, and SAR. Entry requires optional MFI/Fisher oversold filters, a bb_gain threshold, a bullish candle (close > open), and an open below the lower band that closes back at or above the lower band, with volume > 0. Exit either holds (sell=0 if sell_hold) or sells on an upper-band touch/break or when Fisher RSI is above a threshold and SAR is above close.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, it computes MFI, Fisher RSI, weighted Bollinger Bands, EMAs, and SAR. Entry requires optional MFI/Fisher oversold filters, a bb_gain threshold, a bullish candle (close > open), and an open below the lower band that closes back at or above the lower band, with volume > 0. Exit either holds (sell=0 if sell_hold) or sells on an upper-band touch/break or when Fisher RSI is above a threshold and SAR is above close.

families.name: BoomBasticStrategy
families.idea_html: BoomBasticStrategy: The strategy trades on a 5-minute timeframe and can take both long and short positions. Entries require the close to be above (or below for shorts) the Ichimoku senkou spans and a bullish (or bearish) relationship between the 5-minute close and the Heikin-Ashi open, together with an increasing fan magnitude. Exits occur when the 5-minute close crosses the selected trend indicator, with a fixed stoploss of -0.0575 and a stepped minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy trades on a 5-minute timeframe and can take both long and short positions. Entries require the close to be above (or below for shorts) the Ichimoku senkou spans and a bullish (or bearish) relationship between the 5-minute close and the Heikin-Ashi open, together with an increasing fan magnitude. Exits occur when the 5-minute close crosses the selected trend indicator, with a fixed stoploss of -0.0575 and a stepped minimal ROI.

families.name: BuyDips
families.idea_html: BuyDips: The strategy enters long when MACD crosses above its signal line, with optional filters for MFI, a negative MACD, and a Bollinger-band gain condition. Exit signals can be disabled to hold, or they trigger when Parabolic SAR is above close or Fisher RSI exceeds a threshold. The timeframe, stoploss, minimal ROI, and other settings are taken from the configuration.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy enters long when MACD crosses above its signal line, with optional filters for MFI, a negative MACD, and a Bollinger-band gain condition. Exit signals can be disabled to hold, or they trigger when Parabolic SAR is above close or Fisher RSI exceeds a threshold. The timeframe, stoploss, minimal ROI, and other settings are taken from the configuration.

families.name: BuyNStoploss
families.idea_html: BuyNStoploss: The strategy operates on a 1-hour timeframe and uses fixed price levels instead of technical indicators. It buys once when the current price is inside a predefined buy zone, and it sells if the price drops below the lower bound of that zone. The class attributes set a stoploss of -0.99 and a minimal ROI of 10.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy operates on a 1-hour timeframe and uses fixed price levels instead of technical indicators. It buys once when the current price is inside a predefined buy zone, and it sells if the price drops below the zone's lower bound or if a profit threshold based on the open rate is reached. The class attributes set a stoploss of -0.99 and a minimal ROI of 10.

families.name: Cluc4werk
families.idea_html: Cluc4werk: On 1m, it uses a 1h ROCR filter and enters when 1h ROCR is above a threshold and either price is below the shifted lower Bollinger with band-width/close-delta/tail conditions, or close is below EMA slow and below a multiple of the lower Bollinger with volume below mean. It exits when highs and closes stop rising and close times a factor is above the Bollinger middle. It uses trailing stop, stoploss, and a minimal ROI table.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The sheet provides only class attributes: a minimal ROI table, stoploss = -0.02055, and trailing_stop = True. No timeframe, indicator, entry, or exit code is present, so the trading logic cannot be determined from the sheet.

families.name: ClucHAnix5m
families.idea_html: ClucHAnix5m: On a 5m timeframe, it computes Heikin-Ashi candles, EMAs, RSIs, CTI, stochastic and Bollinger bands. Entries are dip-buy lambo rules buying when close is below EMA14 by a factor and RSI(4)/RSI(14) are below limits, with BTC and pump safety filters. Exits use a Fisher overbought signal with Heikin-Ashi lower highs/closes and price above the Bollinger middle, plus ROI/stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it computes Heikin-Ashi candles, EMAs, RSIs, CTI, stochastic and Bollinger bands. Entries are dip-buy lambo rules buying when close is below EMA14 by a factor and RSI(4)/RSI(14) are below limits, with BTC and pump safety filters. Exits use a Fisher overbought signal with Heikin-Ashi lower highs/closes and price above the Bollinger middle, plus ROI/stoploss.

families.name: ClucHAnix_5M_E0V1E
families.idea_html: ClucHAnix_5M_E0V1E: On a 5m timeframe with a 1h informative ROCR filter, it computes Heikin-Ashi, Bollinger bands, EMAs, RSI/Fisher and volume means. It buys when a 1h ROCR is above a threshold and price is below a shifted lower Bollinger band and falling, or below the slow EMA and a lower Bollinger band. Exits use a Fisher overbought signal with Heikin-Ashi lower highs/closes and price above the Bollinger middle.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy inherits indicators and entry logic from a parent class via super() calls. In live or dry-run mode, it manages a trailing buy order: if the parent signals a buy and no trailing order has started, it enables trailing; if a trailing order is already started, it forces a buy signal and tags it. No exit code is shown.

families.name: Comb_ho4_7_H
families.idea_html: Comb_ho4_7_H9: On the 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, it buys when PMAX/MA and moving-average offset conditions are met alongside EWO thresholds, and in some branches RSI14 is below a buy threshold, with volume above zero. Exits include an RSI and six consecutive closes above the upper Bollinger Band condition. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI is 10, with confirm_trade_entry, custom_sell, and informative_pairs hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe with 1h informative data, it buys when PMAX/MA and moving-average offset conditions are met alongside EWO thresholds, and in some branches RSI14 is below a buy threshold, with volume above zero. Exits include an RSI and six consecutive closes above the upper Bollinger Band condition, with use_exit_signal enabled. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI is 10, with confirm_trade_entry, custom_sell, and informative_pairs hooks.

families.name: CombinedBinHAndClucV6H
families.idea_html: CombinedBinHAndClucV6H: The strategy runs on a 5-minute timeframe with 1-hour informative data. The buy condition checks a lower Bollinger band dip with bbdelta/closedelta and tail limits, gated by EMA alignment when the guard is enabled. It exits when close and prior close are above the Bollinger upper band, with a custom stoploss and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy runs on a 5-minute timeframe with 1-hour informative data. The buy condition checks a lower Bollinger band dip with bbdelta/closedelta and tail limits, gated by EMA alignment when the guard is enabled. It exits when close and prior close are above the Bollinger upper band, with a custom stoploss and trailing stop.

families.name: Combined_NFIv7_SMA
families.idea_html: Combined_NFIv7_SMA: The strategy runs on a 5-minute timeframe with 1-hour informative indicators. It enters when RSI fast is below 35, price closes below a lower moving average while opening above it, and an hourly uptrend filter is positive. It exits on RSI overbought and consecutive closes above the bb20_2_upp band, with custom sell logic, trailing stop, and stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy runs on a 5-minute timeframe with 1-hour informative indicators. It enters when RSI fast is below 35, price closes below a lower moving average while opening above it, and an hourly uptrend filter is positive.
