It exits on RSI overbought and consecutive closes above the bb20_2_upp band, with custom sell logic, trailing stop, and a stoploss of -0.30.

families.name: Consumer
families.idea_html: Consumer: On 1m, it consumes producer dataframes from other Freqtrade instances (NFIX, Cluc, BB_RPB) and enters long when a producer's enter_long signal is 1, together with RSI_3m >70, UO_3m >67, UO_2h >57, RSI_4h >63 and positive volume. Exit signals are set to zero. custom_stoploss is present.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1m, it consumes producer dataframes and enters long when the external Consumer enter_long signal is 1 and volume is positive. Exit signals are set to zero. It has minimal ROI, stoploss -0.15, trailing_stop False, and a custom_stoploss hook.

families.name: CryptoFrogNFI
families.idea_html: CryptoFrogNFI: On 5m candles, it looks for long entries when price is below the smoothed Heikin-Ashi low and the 1h fast EMA is below the 1h slow EMA, combined with oversold MFI/stochastic/RSI, lower Bollinger band, or squeeze/expansion conditions. Exits use custom sell conditions including RSI above a threshold and multiple closes above the upper Bollinger band. It uses minimal ROI, a trailing stop, a custom stoploss, and a custom sell hook.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it looks for long entries when price is below the smoothed Heikin-Ashi low and the 1h fast EMA is below the 1h slow EMA, combined with oversold MFI/stochastic/RSI, lower Bollinger band, or squeeze/expansion conditions. Exits use custom sell conditions including RSI above a threshold and multiple closes above the upper Bollinger band. It uses minimal ROI, a trailing stop, a custom stoploss, and a custom sell hook.

families.name: DIV
families.idea_html: DIV_v1: On 5m timeframe, it computes RSI and a bullish RSI divergence. It buys when a bullish divergence is present, RSI is below 30, and volume is positive. There is no sell rule; exits are handled by ROI, a -15% stoploss, and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m timeframe, it computes RSI and a divergence flag named regular_bear_div_rsi. It buys when that divergence flag is true, RSI is below 30, and volume is positive. There is no sell rule; exits use ROI, a -5% stoploss, and trailing stop.

families.name: DNSAlarm
families.idea_html: DNSAlarm: On 1h timeframe, this strategy computes DNS bull/bear zones and emits alarms or commands. Its buy and sell rules are empty, so it does not generate normal entry or exit signals. It has a -0.99 stoploss and minimal_roi of 10.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1w timeframe, it calculates bull/bear engulfing lines and a TradeManager, then uses a buy_criteria column for entries and sell_criteria for exits. The sheet does not show how these criteria are built. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal_roi is 10.

families.name: DWT_Predict
families.idea_html: DWT_Predict: On 5m, computes Fisher-transformed RSI/Williams %R and a model prediction/diff. It enters long when volume is present, fisher_wr is at or below -0.5 (or 0.0 if guards are disabled) and model_diff is above threshold with model_predict rising. Exits when fisher_wr is at or above 0.5 (or 0.0) and model_diff falls below the exit threshold, with stoploss -0.10.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, uses Fisher-transformed RSI/Williams %R plus a model prediction/diff. Long entries require volume, fisher_wr below -0.5 (or 0.0) and model_diff above threshold with model_predict rising. Exits occur when fisher_wr is above 0.5 (or 0.0) and model_diff is below the exit threshold, with stoploss -0.10.

families.name: Darq
families.idea_html: Darq: On the 3m timeframe, the strategy trades both long and short. Long entries require price above a higher-timeframe resampled SMA, an EMA short/long bullish cross, ADX above an entry threshold, OBV above its 5-period mean, RSI below 80, and MACD above its signal; short entries mirror these conditions. Exits occur when ADX falls below an exit threshold, and ROI, a -0.02 stoploss, and trailing stop are also configured.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, the strategy trades both long and short. Long entries require price above a higher-timeframe resampled SMA, an EMA short/long bullish cross, ADX above an entry threshold, OBV above its 5-period mean, RSI below 80, and MACD above its signal; short entries mirror these conditions. Exits occur when ADX falls below an exit threshold, and ROI, a -0.5 stoploss, and trailing stop are also configured.

families.name: DefaultStrategy
families.idea_html: DefaultStrategy: The fact sheet does not specify a timeframe. It buys when RSI and fastd are below 35 with ADX above 30 and +DI above 0.5, or when ADX is above 65 with +DI above 0.5. It sells when RSI or fastd crosses above 70 with ADX above 10 and -DI above 0, or when ADX is above 70 and -DI above 0.5, using ROI targets and a -0.10 stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet does not specify a timeframe. It buys when RSI and fastd are below 35 with ADX above 30 and +DI above 0.5, or when ADX is above 65 with +DI above 0.5. It sells when RSI or fastd crosses above 70 with ADX above 10 and -DI above 0, or when ADX is above 70 and -DI above 0.5, using ROI targets and a -0.10 stoploss.

families.name: DonchianBounce
families.idea_html: DonchianBounce: It enters long when close crosses above the lower Donchian channel after having been below it, with optional SAR, SMA, EMA, ADX, and distance-from-upper filters. It exits when close crosses below the upper Donchian channel, unless sell_hold is set. Timeframe, stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI come from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It enters long when close crosses above the lower Donchian channel after having been below it, with optional SAR, SMA, EMA, ADX, and distance-from-upper filters. It exits when close crosses below the upper Donchian channel, unless sell_hold is set. Timeframe, stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI come from Config.

families.name: DonchianChannel
families.idea_html: DonchianChannel: It enters long when close is at or above the upper Donchian channel, with optional SAR, SMA200, EMA50, MFI, ADX, DM, MACD, and Fisher filters. It exits when close crosses below the lower Donchian channel, unless sell_hold is set. Timeframe, stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI come from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: DonchianChannel_2 enters when price closes at or above the Donchian upper channel, with optional SAR, SMA200, EMA50, MFI, ADX, DM, MACD and Fisher RSI conditions. It exits when price crosses below the Donchian lower channel. Timeframe and stoploss are taken from Config, and a sell_hold flag can disable exit signals.

families.name: EI1_t4c0s
families.idea_html: EI1_t4c0s: EI1_t4c0s is a 1h dip-buying strategy with multiple long entry branches. It buys when price is below an EMA or offset moving average and RSI or stochastic readings are low, with some branches requiring EWO conditions and an ATR percentage above a minimum. Exits fire when price and RSI are above moving-average/offset levels or when price is below HMA50 but above another offset MA, and the strategy uses custom entry price, custom sell, custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss and no position adjustment.

other_descriptions.idea_html: EI1_t4c0s_V4 is a 1h dip-buying strategy with several long entry branches. It buys when price is below an EMA or offset moving average and RSI or stochastic readings are low, with some branches requiring EWO conditions and an ATR percentage above a minimum; rolling max/min windows define offset levels. Exits fire when price and RSI are above moving-average/offset levels or when price is below HMA50 but above another offset MA, and it uses custom entry price, custom sell, custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss and no position adjustment.

families.name: EI4_t4c0s
families.idea_html: EI4_t4c0s_V2: EI4_t4c0s_V2 is a 5m dip-buying strategy with several long entry branches. It buys when price is below an EMA or offset moving average and RSI or stochastic readings are low, with some branches requiring EWO conditions and an ATR percentage above a minimum. Exits fire when price and RSI are above moving-average/offset levels or when price is below HMA50 but above another offset MA, and it uses custom entry price, custom exit, custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss and no position adjustment.

other_descriptions.idea_html: EI4_t4c0s_V2_2 is a 5m dip-buying strategy with several long entry branches. It buys when price is below an EMA or offset moving average and RSI or stochastic readings are low, with some branches requiring EWO conditions and an ATR percentage above a minimum. Exits fire when price and RSI are above moving-average/offset levels or when price is below HMA50 but above another offset MA, and it uses custom entry price, custom exit, custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss and no position adjustment.

families.name: EMABounce
families.idea_html: EMABounce: This strategy buys when the slope of the short EMA (linear-regression angle) crosses above zero and the EMA difference is positive, with volume above zero; an optional MACD-histogram >= 0 filter can be switched on. It exits when the EMA angle crosses below zero while the close is above the long EMA and the EMA difference is within the sell-diff tolerance. Timeframe, trailing stop, stoploss and minimal ROI come from the shared Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy buys when the short-EMA slope crosses above zero and the EMA difference is positive, on volume above zero, with an optional MACD-histogram >= 0 condition. It exits when the EMA angle crosses below zero while the close is above the long EMA and the EMA difference is not too negative. Timeframe, trailing stop, stoploss and minimal ROI are taken from the shared Config.

families.name: EMABreakout
families.idea_html: EMABreakout: On the 5m timeframe, this strategy buys when the close crosses above a configurable-period EMA while volume is above zero; an optional MACD-histogram >= 0 filter may be enabled. It exits when the close crosses back below that EMA, unless sell-hold is on. A trailing stop, a -0.333 stoploss and a minimal-ROI ladder handle risk.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This 5m strategy enters long when the close crosses above a configurable EMA, with volume above zero and an optional MACD-histogram >= 0 filter. It exits when the close crosses back below the EMA, or holds if sell-hold is enabled. Risk is managed with a trailing stop, a -0.333 stoploss and a minimal-ROI table.

families.name: Enchilada
families.idea_html: Enchilada: On a 5m timeframe, it buys when TV consensus buy and 1h consensus exceed X, up_trend is 1, RMI-slow is at least 55 and above its 3-period mean, volume is below 30 times its 24-period mean, recent closes are rising, and SAR is below close. If a trade is already active, the buy condition changes to current peak ratio > 0.8 and RMI-slow >= 60. It sells an active trade when current profit is negative but above stoploss, dn_trend is 1, RMI-fast < 50, and volume is positive, with an extra condition on average other-trade profit; stoploss is -0.085.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet only provides class attributes for a 1h strategy with minimal ROI steps and a -0.085 stoploss. No populate_indicators, entry, or exit code is present, so the trading logic cannot be determined from the sheet. No concrete trading logic labels are supported.

families.name: Ewt
families.idea_html: Ewt2: Ewt2 trades on a 5-minute timeframe and merges an informative timeframe with EWO and EMA32 indicators, also calculating BTC EWO. It enters long when EWO_BUY turns up above buy_EWO_val after recent negative readings and open is above ema32, or when EWO_BUY is below -7.00. It exits when EWO_SELL is at or below sell_EWO_val, with minimal_roi of 0.5 and stoploss at -0.1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Ewt3 trades on a 5-minute timeframe and calculates an EWO from configured SMA lengths together with an EMA. It enters long when EWO is above buy_EWO and open is above the EMA, or when EWO is below buy_EWO_low. It exits when EWO is at or below sell_EWO, with minimal_roi 0.31 and stoploss -0.1.

families.name: FRAYSTRAT
families.idea_html: FRAYSTRAT: FRAYSTRAT trades on a 15-minute timeframe with trailing stop and a -0.1 stoploss, using RSI, MACD, Bollinger bands, EMA7/EMA12, and TEMA. It enters long on RSI crossing above buy_rsi while TEMA is below the BB middle and rising below ema7, or on RSI above 40 and rising with ema7 below ema12 and MACD signal above MACD, or on MACD signal below MACD with ema7 above ema12 and rising TEMA. It exits on RSI crossing above sell_rsi with TEMA above the BB middle and falling, or on EMA/TEMA conditions.

other_descriptions.idea_html: FRAYSTRAT_BTCUSDT_1H trades on a 15-minute timeframe with trailing stop, a -0.229 stoploss, and a stepped minimal_roi. It enters long on RSI crossing above buy_rsi while close is below the BB middle and TEMA is rising below ema7, or on RSI above 51 and rising with ema7 below ema12 and MACD signal above MACD, or on MACD signal below MACD with ema7 above ema12 and rising TEMA. It exits on RSI crossing above sell_rsi with close above the BB middle and falling TEMA, or on EMA/TEMA conditions.

families.name: Freqtrade_backtest_validation_freqtrade
families.idea_html: Freqtrade_backtest_validation_freqtrade1: On a 1h timeframe, it calculates a 14-period fast SMA and a 28-period slow SMA. It enters long when the fast SMA is above the slow SMA and exits when the fast SMA falls below the slow SMA. It has a -0.90 stoploss and a minimal ROI schedule with very high profit targets.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1h timeframe, it calculates a 14-period fast SMA and a 28-period slow SMA. It sets a buy signal when the fast SMA is above the slow SMA and a sell signal when the fast SMA is below the slow SMA. It has a -0.90 stoploss and a minimal ROI schedule with very high profit targets.

families.name: GKD_Baseline
families.idea_html: GKD_Baseline: On 1h, it builds a moving-average indicator selected from a large family of MA functions. It enters long when price_above flips from False to True and close is between goldie_min and goldie_max, with an optional short when price_below flips true. It exits long when price_below is true and exits short when price_above is true, using a -0.10 stoploss and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 1h timeframe, it enters long when price_above flips from false to true and close is within the goldie_min/goldie_max zone, and enters short when price_below flips true under the same zone. It exits long on price_below and exits short on price_above. The class uses a 10% stoploss, trailing stop, and a tiered minimal ROI.

families.name: GKD_FisherTransform
families.idea_html: GKD_FisherTransform: On the 1h timeframe, the long entry triggers when the 6h Fisher value is below a threshold and its smoothed 6h value is below the raw Fisher. If shorting is enabled, it shorts when the smoothed Fisher is below a threshold, the EMA baseline slope is down, and close is inside the goldie_min/goldie_max ATR zone. Long exits when the smoothed 6h Fisher weakens or turns bearish, while short exits when the Fisher is above zero. It uses a 10% stoploss and no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 1h timeframe, the long entry triggers when the smoothed Fisher is rising, the 4h Fisher is below a threshold, and the smoothed 4h Fisher is below the raw 4h Fisher. If shorting is enabled, it shorts when the smoothed Fisher is below a threshold, the EMA baseline slope is down, and close is inside the goldie_min/goldie_max ATR zone. Long exits when the smoothed 4h Fisher weakens or turns bearish, while short exits when the Fisher is above zero. It uses a 10% stoploss and no trailing stop.

families.name: GeneStrategy
families.idea_html: GeneStrategy: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long on a DIP signal when RMI, CCI and stochastic RSI are below thresholds, close is below a lower Bollinger band, ROC 1h is negative, and Bollinger width conditions are met. Position adjustment and custom sell/stoploss hooks are enabled, while the shown exit block checks Fisher, Heikin-Ashi highs/closes and EMA/BB middle conditions but assigns the 'exit' column to 0. It uses a minimal ROI of 100, stoploss -0.99, and no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long on a DIP signal when RMI, CCI and stochastic RSI are below thresholds, close is below a lower Bollinger band, ROC 1h is negative, and Bollinger width conditions are met. Position adjustment and custom sell/stoploss hooks are enabled, while the shown exit block checks Fisher, Heikin-Ashi highs/closes and EMA/BB middle conditions but assigns the 'exit' column to 0. It uses a minimal ROI of 100, stoploss -0.99, and no trailing stop.

families.name: GnF
families.idea_html: A synthetic greed/fear index decides the direction: momentum (close against SMA20), volatility (NATR14) and a volume sentiment (up-volume minus down-volume) are each min-max normalised over a 20-bar window and averaged into one 0-1 number. Above 0.7 the strategy is long, below 0.3 short, and a trade is only opened while volume exceeds its own 50-bar mean; the opposite threshold closes the side, so the index crossing the band is what turns the position.
version_rows: 75 lines using ta.ATR and carrying a longer plot_config.

The revision the description is read from switches to ta.NATR - which matters because the index divides volatility by price - and shortens the plot_config. Two revisions in the corpus, one of them a refinement of the same index.
families.read_from_html: Read from GnF_V2 sha256_3e095a5da824d1b...: the corpus still holds it
details_items: populate_indicators: momentum = (close - SMA20)/SMA20, volatility = ta.NATR(14), volume_up/volume_down -> volume_sentiment, each normalised over rolling(20), greed_fear_index = mean of the three
populate_entry_trend: enter_long where greed_fear_index > 0.7 and volume > volume_mean; enter_short where < 0.3
populate_exit_trend: exit_long where greed_fear_index < 0.3, exit_short where > 0.7
settings: stoploss -0.99, minimal_roi {}, trailing_stop False

families.name: Gold
families.idea_html: Gold7: Gold7 on 5m builds a volume_buy tag but explicitly sets enter_long to 0, and it defines a short-side condition using extrema/maxima, RSI above 70, StochRSI above 80, and higher RSI filters. It exits short on an extrema signal equal to -1 and exits long when prob_down is above 49. The class has stoploss -0.99, trailing_stop False, position_adjustment_enable False, and can_short False.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Gold8 on 5m builds a volume_buy tag but sets enter_long to 0, and it defines an nfi_33 long-side condition requiring close below ema_13 by an offset, EWO above 8, CTI below -0.88, RSI below 32, r_14 below -98, volume below a volume_mean_4 multiple, and ADX above 30. The exit code exits long when prob_down is above 49. The class has stoploss -0.99, trailing_stop False, and position_adjustment_enable False.

families.name: GymStrategy
families.idea_html: GymStrategy: Entry and exit signals come from an RL model prediction: buy is set when action == 1 and sell when action == 2, with rows flagged in nan_list blocked. The indicator function calculates a wide set of technical indicators such as ADX, Aroon, MACD, RSI, stochastic, MFI, ROC, and Bollinger Bands. The class uses stoploss -0.20, no trailing stop, and process_only_new_candles is False.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Entry and exit signals come from an RL model prediction: buy is set when action == 1 and sell when action == 2, with rows flagged in nan_list blocked. The indicator function calculates a wide set of technical indicators such as ADX, Aroon, MACD, RSI, stochastic, MFI, ROC, and Bollinger Bands. The class uses stoploss -0.20, no trailing stop, and process_only_new_candles is False.

families.name: HourBasedStrategy
families.idea_html: HourBasedStrategy: It works on a 1h timeframe. It opens a trade whenever the candle hour falls between the configured buy-hour minimum and maximum, and the shown exit code instead sets a buy flag when the hour falls in the configured sell range. Risk is managed with a fixed stoploss and a minimal_roi schedule.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It works on a 1h timeframe. It buys during the configured buy-hour window and the exit code marks a sell during the configured sell-hour window using max and min reversed. It uses a fixed stoploss and a minimal_roi schedule.

families.name: Ichi_trigger
families.idea_html: Ichi_trigger: On a 5m timeframe, it uses do_indicators and an informative timeframe, then enters long when bs_pic_sig is greater than pic_l_s_trig. It exits when bs_pic_sig is less than pic_l_s_trig. It has a very high minimal_roi and a -99% stoploss, but the custom signal definitions are not shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it prepares indicators through do_indicators and enters long when bs_pic_sig is above pic_l_s_trig. It exits when bs_pic_sig falls below pic_l_s_trig, prints tenkan values in the entry code, and uses a very high minimal_roi with a -99% stoploss. The custom signal definitions are not shown.

families.name: Ichis
families.idea_html: Ichis: Ichis trades on the 1h timeframe. It enters when the Ichimoku go_long condition crosses above zero while the SSL channel is in an up state and an up_trend filter is active. It exits on a bearish SSL cross combined with either tenkan crossing below kijun or close crossing below kijun, and uses a 1% stoploss with trailing stop and an ROI ladder.

other_descriptions.idea_html: IchisV1_2 trades on 5m and builds EMA-based multi-timeframe trend closes plus Ichimoku. Entry requires one or more of those trend close series to be above the Senkou A and B cloud levels, as configured by buy_trend_above_senkou_level. Exit occurs when the 5m trend close crosses below a selected sell trend indicator, with a 27.5% stoploss and no trailing stop.

families.name: Inverse
families.idea_html: Inverse: Inverse trades on 1h. It enters on a Fisher CCI cross above a buy threshold, or after a recent dip below a lower threshold and a cross back above it, and requires SSL and EMA trend filters (EMA50 > EMA200 and informative EMA alignment). It exits when Fisher CCI crosses below a sell threshold, and uses a 20% stoploss with trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: InverseV2 trades on 1h. It enters on a Fisher CCI cross above a buy threshold, or after a recent dip below a lower threshold and a cross back above it, and requires SSL and EMA trend filters plus an informative BTC CCI below zero. It exits when Fisher CCI crosses below a sell threshold, and uses a 20% stoploss with trailing stop.

families.name: KeltnerBounce
families.idea_html: KeltnerBounce: On the configured timeframe, it buys when the previous candle touched or closed below the lower Keltner band and the current candle is green while its open and close sit between the lower and middle Keltner bands. Optional MFI, Fisher RSI and Bollinger-gain filters plus a volume check can be included. It exits when the open or close is above the upper Keltner band, with stoploss and trailing stop taken from config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, it buys when the previous candle touched or closed below the lower Keltner band and the current candle is green while its open and close sit between the lower and middle Keltner bands. Optional MFI, Fisher RSI and Bollinger-gain filters plus a volume check can be included. It exits when the open or close is above the upper Keltner band, with stoploss and trailing stop taken from config.

families.name: KeltnerChannels
families.idea_html: KeltnerChannels: On the configured timeframe, it goes long when close is at or above the upper Keltner band and, per the docstring, above the 200 SMA. Optional SAR, SMA, EMA, MFI, ADX, directional movement, MACD and Fisher RSI conditions can be enabled as filters. It exits when close is below the lower Keltner band unless sell_hold is set, with stoploss and trailing stop from config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, it goes long when close is at or above the upper Keltner band and, per the docstring, above the 200 SMA. Optional SAR, SMA, EMA, MFI, ADX, directional movement, MACD and Fisher RSI conditions can be enabled as filters. It exits when close is below the lower Keltner band unless sell_hold is set, with stoploss and trailing stop from config.

families.name: KeltnerRSI
families.idea_html: KeltnerRSI: On the 1d timeframe, it buys when close crosses above the upper Keltner band while RSI is above 55. It sells when close crosses below the Keltner middle band. Stoploss is -0.254 and minimal ROI is set to 100.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 8h timeframe, it buys when close crosses above the upper Keltner band while RSI is above 55. It sells when close crosses below the Keltner middle band. Stoploss is -0.10 and minimal ROI is set to 100.

families.name: Lateralus
families.idea_html: Lateralus: On 5m, when no trade is active it requires higher-timeframe EMA fast above EMA slow and MACD above signal, then buys either a close below the previous lower Bollinger band with a small candle tail or a close below EMA-slow and lower-bb2 with low volume. When a trade is active, it also has an active-trade buy condition using peak profit and rmi-slow. It exits on negative profit with dn_trend, rmi-fast crossing below 50, and volume, plus an other-trade profit check; stoploss is -0.085.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet provides only class attributes: a 1h timeframe, a tiered minimal ROI, and a stoploss of -0.085. No indicator, entry, or exit code is present, so no trading logic can be read from the sheet.

families.name: Lmao
families.idea_html: Lmao: On a 5m timeframe, it enters long on a DIP signal when RMI, CCI, and SRSI are below thresholds, BB delta/width conditions hold, close is below a lower Bollinger band factor, and 1h ROC and BB-width filters agree. BTC 20/25 EMAs are used to compute a down state, and the strategy enables position adjustment with custom exit and custom stoploss hooks. The exit code evaluates Fisher and Heikin-Ashi conditions but sets exit_long to 0, while stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI is tiered.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet shows only a custom_stoploss hook. No indicator, entry, or exit code is present, so the trading logic cannot be determined from the sheet.

families.name: LongShortRangeTradingMachetes
families.idea_html: LongShortRangeTradingMachetesV1: On a 1m timeframe with 500 startup candles, the entry sets buy when entry_signal equals 1 and the exit sets sell when exit_signal equals 1. Both signals are produced by on_populate_buy_trend and on_populate_sell_trend methods that are not shown, and custom sell/stoploss hooks are present. Minimal ROI starts at 1 and stoploss is -0.1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1m timeframe with 500 startup candles, the entry sets buy when entry_signal equals 1 and the exit sets sell when exit_signal equals 1. Both signals are produced by on_populate_buy_trend and on_populate_sell_trend methods that are not shown, and custom sell/stoploss hooks are present. Minimal ROI starts at 1 and stoploss is -0.1.

families.name: Low_BBHO
families.idea_html: Low_BBHO: On a 1m timeframe, it buys when close is at or below buy_limit times the lower Bollinger band, with Bollinger bands and MACD populated. The exit code contains an empty sell condition, and the strategy uses a -0.263 stoploss with a tiered minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it buys when close is at or below buy_limit times the lower Bollinger band, using Bollinger bands and MACD indicators. The exit code contains an empty sell condition, and the strategy uses a -0.263 stoploss with a tiered minimal ROI.

families.name: MAC
families.idea_html: MAC: On the 1-day timeframe, it enters long when EMA50 crosses above EMA200 and volume is positive. It exits when EMA50 crosses below EMA200 while volume is positive. It uses a minimal ROI and a -15% stoploss, with no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 1d timeframe, enters when EMA20 crosses above EMA50 and volume is nonzero. Exits when EMA20 crosses below EMA50 and volume is nonzero. Uses a -0.15 stoploss and a minimal ROI value.

families.name: MACDCross
families.idea_html: MACDCross: Entry is driven by MACD crossing above its signal line, with positive volume required. Optional parameter-gated filters can require ADX, DM, MFI, SAR, Fisher RSI, negative MACD, or Bollinger gain conditions. Exit is either disabled while holding or triggered by MACD crossing below its signal line with an optional positive-MACD condition; timeframe and stoploss come from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Entry is driven by MACD crossing above its signal line, with positive volume required. Optional parameter-gated filters can require ADX, DM, MFI, SAR, Fisher RSI, negative MACD, or Bollinger gain conditions. Exit is either disabled while holding or triggered by MACD crossing below its signal line with an optional positive-MACD condition; timeframe and stoploss come from Config.

families.name: MACDRSI
families.idea_html: MACDRSI: It enters long when RSI is between 30 and 70, the fast MACD histogram is positive while its shift(-1) value is negative, and the slower MACD histogram is negative and declining across shift(-1) and shift(-2) comparisons. It exits when the fast MACD line crosses below its signal line. It uses a minimal ROI and a -10% stoploss; the timeframe is not specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It enters long when the 8-period rolling minimum of RSI is below 41, the close is above the 200-period EMA, and MACD crosses above its signal line. It exits when the 8-period rolling maximum of RSI is above 93, MACD is positive, and MACD crosses below its signal line. It uses a -4.032% stoploss and a multi-step minimal ROI; the timeframe is not specified.

families.name: MACDTurn
families.idea_html: MACDTurn: Enters when the MACD histogram is negative and its slope crosses above zero, with optional parameter-gated filters for ADX, DM, MFI, SAR, Fisher RSI, negative MACD, and Bollinger gain. Exits either never when sell_hold is true, or when MACD is above zero if sell_macd_enabled is set. Uses config values for timeframe, stoploss, ROI, and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Enters when the MACD histogram is negative and its slope crosses above zero, with optional parameter-gated filters for ADX, DM, MFI, SAR, Fisher RSI, negative MACD, and Bollinger gain. Exits either never when sell_hold is true, or when MACD is above zero if sell_macd_enabled is set. Uses config values for timeframe, stoploss, ROI, and trailing stop.

families.name: MFIRSICross
families.idea_html: MFIRSICross: Buys when the acceleration of the MFI-RSI average difference crosses above zero, optionally filtered by MFI at or below a threshold. Exits when MFI is at or above 80 and that acceleration crosses below zero, unless sell-hold is enabled. Timeframe and risk settings come from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Buys when the acceleration of the MFI-RSI average difference crosses above zero, optionally filtered by MFI at or below a threshold. Exits when MFI is at or above 80 and that acceleration crosses below zero, unless sell-hold is enabled. Timeframe and risk settings come from Config.

families.name: MLStrategy
families.idea_html: MLStrategy: Uses per-pair machine-learning models to generate buy and sell predictions from a dataframe with SMA, RSI and Bollinger Band features. Buys when the model predicts for pairs in its pair list, and sells on a separate model prediction. Timeframe is 5m and stoploss is -0.271.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Uses per-pair machine-learning models to generate buy predictions from SMA, RSI and Bollinger Band features. The sell signal is set to zero, so exits rely on stoploss or ROI rather than a model sell prediction. Timeframe is 5m and stoploss is -0.271.

families.name: Money
families.idea_html: Money: On 1h candles it enters long when RSI is below buy_rsi and the short EMA is above the long EMA. The exit/short code fires when RSI is above sell_rsi and the short EMA is below the long EMA. Stoploss is -0.4, shorting is enabled, and trailing stop is true.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles it enters long when RSI is below buy_rsi and the short EMA is above the long EMA. The exit/short code fires when RSI is above sell_rsi and the short EMA is below the long EMA. Stoploss is -0.4, shorting is enabled, and trailing stop is true.

families.name: MyAwesomeStrategy
families.idea_html: MyAwesomeStrategy: On a 1h timeframe, it computes ADX, Awesome Oscillator, and MACD. It enters when MACD is above zero and the Awesome Oscillator crosses from negative to positive. It exits when MACD is below zero and the Awesome Oscillator crosses from positive to negative. Stoploss is -0.25, trailing stop is on, and minimal ROI is 0.1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1d timeframe, it builds entry conditions from optional ADX and RSI filters plus a configurable buy trigger. The trigger can be a close below the lower Bollinger band or a MACD cross above its signal line. No sell signal conditions are defined, so exits come from ROI or the -0.10 stoploss; trailing stop is off.

families.name: NASOSv5_antipump
families.idea_html: NASOSv5_antipump: The entry buys when RSI and fast RSI are low, price is below the buy moving average by an offset, EWO is above a threshold, and pump strength is below an antipump threshold. The exit can trigger on four consecutive equal highs, an overbought RSI/momentum condition, or a close below HMA50. No timeframe or stoploss is shown in the fact sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys when fast RSI is low, price is below the buy moving average by an offset, EWO is above a threshold, RSI is low, and price is below a sell moving average offset. It exits on an overbought RSI/momentum condition or when price is below HMA50 while above a sell moving average. Stoploss is -0.15 and minimal ROI is set to 0 after 360 minutes.

families.name: NDrop
families.idea_html: NDrop: The entry buys when MFI is below a threshold, Fisher RSI is low, close is at or below the lower Bollinger band, there have been consecutive down candles, and price has dropped by a set percentage. The exit signal is disabled (sell=0), so trades are closed by the configured ROI and stoploss. Timeframe and stoploss are taken from Config, not hardcoded.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The entry buys when MFI is below a threshold, Fisher RSI is low, close is at or below the lower Bollinger band, there have been consecutive down candles, and price has dropped by a set percentage. The exit signal is disabled (sell=0), so trades are closed by the configured ROI and stoploss. Timeframe and stoploss are taken from Config, not hardcoded.

families.name: NFI46Frog
families.idea_html: NFI46Frog: On 5m candles, it buys dips when the 1h EMA50 is above EMA200 and 1h/5m RSI and MFI are low, with safe_dips and safe_pump filters and price near the lower Bollinger band. It exits when RSI is high and price has closed above the upper Bollinger band for several candles. Stoploss is -1.0, minimal ROI is 10 at 0 minutes, and custom sell and custom stoploss hooks are present.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys dips when the 1h EMA50 is above EMA200 and 1h/5m RSI and MFI are low, with safe_dips and safe_pump filters and price near the lower Bollinger band. It exits when RSI is high and price has closed above the upper Bollinger band for several candles. Stoploss is -0.99, minimal ROI steps from 0.028 at 0 minutes to 0.018 at 180 minutes, and custom sell and custom stoploss hooks are present.

families.name: NFI46Z
families.idea_html: NFI46Z: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative indicators, entry requires a 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising SMA200, together with dip conditions such as RSI and MFI below thresholds or close under a lower Bollinger band offset. Exit signals fire when RSI is high and close has been above the upper Bollinger band for six consecutive candles. Stoploss is -0.99, minimal ROI starts at 2.8%, and custom_sell/custom_stoploss hooks are present.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe with 1h informative indicators, entry requires a 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising SMA200, together with dip conditions such as RSI and MFI below thresholds or close under a lower Bollinger band offset. Exit signals fire when RSI is high and close has been above the upper Bollinger band for six consecutive candles. Stoploss is -0.99, minimal ROI starts at 2.8%, and custom_sell/custom_stoploss hooks are present.

families.name: NFINextMOHO
families.idea_html: NFINextMOHO: Operates on a 5m timeframe. Entries require 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising 200-period SMA, plus oversold RSI/MFI and a close below a scaled lower Bollinger band, with safe pump/dip filters. Exits when RSI is high and price has held above the bb20_2_upp upper band for several candles; stoploss is -0.99, trailing stop disabled, and minimal ROI is 10 at time 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Operates on a 5m timeframe. Entries require 1h EMA50 above EMA200 and a rising 200-period SMA, plus oversold RSI/MFI and a close below a scaled lower Bollinger band, with safe pump/dip filters. Exits when RSI is high and price has held above the bb20_2_upp upper band for several candles; stoploss is -0.99, trailing stop disabled, and minimal ROI is 0.01 at time 0.

families.name: NFINextMultiOffsetAndHO
families.idea_html: NFINextMultiOffsetAndHO: Operates on a 5m timeframe. The visible entry code only builds dynamic buy protections such as EMA alignment and rising SMA checks; the core buy trigger is truncated. The exit code sells when close is above a moving-average offset sell level, with stoploss -0.99, trailing stop disabled, and minimal ROI 10 at time 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Operates on a 5m timeframe. The visible entry code only builds dynamic buy protections; the core buy trigger is truncated. The sell-trend function returns 0, with stoploss -0.99, trailing stop enabled, and minimal ROI 10 at time 0.

families.name: NNPredict_Wavenet
families.idea_html: NNPredict_Wavenet: The fact sheet contains only the class attributes header and empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No timeframe, entry trigger, exit rule, or other trading logic is provided. Thus the strategy cannot be classified beyond other.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet contains only the class attributes header and empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No timeframe, entry trigger, exit rule, or other trading logic is provided. Thus the strategy cannot be classified beyond other.

families.name: NOTankAi_15_Cleaned
families.idea_html: NOTankAi_15_Cleaned: On 15m, it enters long at a local price minimum when RSI is below 30, DI_catch is active, no recent maxima are present, a prior minima exists, and volume is positive. It exits long at a local maximum or when maxima_check/volume conditions trigger, with position adjustment enabled. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI starts at 50%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m, it enters long at a local price minimum when RSI is below 30, DI_catch is active, no recent maxima are present, a prior minima exists, and volume is positive. It exits long at a local maximum or when maxima_check/volume conditions trigger, without position adjustment. Stoploss is -0.99 and minimal ROI starts at 50%.

families.name: NSeq
families.idea_html: NSeq: This strategy uses MFI, Fisher RSI, weighted Bollinger lower band, and a multi-candle drop as entry conditions, plus a current green candle after red candles. Sell signal is set to zero, so exits rely on the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing settings. Timeframe, stoploss, and ROI are taken from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy uses MFI, Fisher RSI, weighted Bollinger lower band, and a multi-candle drop as entry conditions, plus a current green candle after red candles. Sell signal is set to zero, so exits rely on the configured ROI, stoploss, and trailing settings. Timeframe and use_sell_signal are taken from Config.

families.name: NotAnotherSMAOffsetStrategyModHO
families.idea_html: NotAnotherSMAOffsetStrategyModHO: On 5m candles, this strategy enters when RSI_fast is below 35, close is below an EMA buy offset, and EWO is above a high threshold or below a low threshold. It exits on sell signals using SMA9 or HMA50 with EMA sell offsets and RSI_fast above RSI_slow. It has a custom_stoploss, a -0.32 stoploss, and a trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, this strategy enters when RSI_fast is below 35, close is below an EMA buy offset, and EWO is above a high threshold or below a low threshold. It exits on sell signals using SMA9 or HMA50 with EMA sell offsets and RSI_fast above RSI_slow. It has a custom_stoploss, a -0.9 stoploss, and a trailing stop.

families.name: Notank_unbiased
families.idea_html: Notank_unbiased: On 15-minute candles entries are taken when DI_catch is 1 (DI+ minus DI- at or below zero), a maxima_check and a pivot extrema line up with a detected rolling minimum two bars back, and RSI is below 30, so buys occur at detected price lows. Exits come from a maxima_check or a pivot maximum two bars back. Position adjustment is enabled with up to 2 extra entries, plus custom entry price and leverage hooks, with a -0.99 stoploss and a long minimal ROI ladder.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15-minute candles it buys when DI_catch is 1, the rolling minima/maxima checks line up with a pivot minimum and RSI is below 30, i.e. at detected price lows. Exits are triggered by a maxima_check or a pivot maximum. Position adjustment allows up to 2 extra entries via the adjust_trade_position hook, with a -0.3 stoploss and a long minimal ROI ladder.

families.name: NowoIchimoku1h
families.idea_html: NowoIchimoku1hV1: On 1-hour candles it buys when the Ichimoku cloud is green, the conversion (Tenkan) line is above the base (Kijun) line, price is above the shifted upper cloud by 4%, above the shifted lower cloud and above the double-shifted upper cloud, and the candle is bullish. A buy_allowed loop blocks a new entry until the cloud stops being green. No sell signal is produced, so trades end via the -0.08 stoploss or the custom_stoploss hook, with minimal ROI effectively disabled.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1-hour candles it enters when the Ichimoku cloud is green, the conversion line is above the base line, price is above the shifted upper cloud (multiplier from a parameter), above the shifted lower and double-shifted upper clouds, and the candle is bullish. A per-row loop suppresses new entries until the cloud turns non-green. Exits come from the -0.345 stoploss, a custom_stoploss hook and a trailing stop with a minimal ROI ladder; the sell function sets sell to 0.

families.name: Obelisk_3EMA_StochRSI_ATR
families.idea_html: Obelisk_3EMA_StochRSI_ATR: Obelisk 3EMA StochRSI ATR runs on a 5m timeframe and uses a combined go_long signal from 3EMA, StochRSI, and ATR indicators. It enters when go_long crosses above zero, and the sell signal is disabled. Risk is managed by a custom stoploss with a -0.99 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Obelisk 3EMA StochRSI ATR 259 runs on a 5m timeframe and uses a combined go_long signal from 3EMA, StochRSI, and ATR indicators. It enters when go_long crosses above zero, and the sell signal is disabled. Risk is managed by a custom stoploss with a -0.99 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 1.

families.name: PCA
families.idea_html: PCA: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when volume is positive, MFI is below 30, close is below TEMA, and the PCA buy classifier crosses above 0.5. It exits when volume is positive, MFI is above 70, close is above TEMA, and the PCA sell classifier crosses above 0.5. It has custom exit and custom stoploss hooks, a -99% stoploss, and a 0.6% minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it can go long when Fisher WR is below -0.98, close is below the Bollinger middle band, and the PCA buy classifier is 1; it can short when Fisher WR is above 0.94, close is above the Bollinger middle band, and the PCA sell classifier is 1. Long exits require close above the Bollinger middle band, Fisher WR above 0.5, and the PCA sell classifier crossing above 0.5. It has a -3% stoploss, trailing stop, and leverage/custom hooks.

families.name: PRICEFOLLOWING
families.idea_html: PRICEFOLLOWING: On the 5m timeframe, it buys when EMA7 crosses below TEMA, and optionally when RSI is below a configured value; if RSI is disabled, it also requires TEMA to be falling. It sells when EMA7 crosses above TEMA, optionally with an RSI filter. It has a -10% stoploss, trailing stop, and staged minimal ROI targets.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 15m timeframe, it buys when EMA7 crosses below TEMA, and optionally when RSI is below a configured value; if RSI is disabled, it also requires the EMA7/TEMA gap to be within an EMA percentage threshold. It sells when EMA7 crosses above TEMA, optionally with RSI, best bid below Heikin-Ashi close, and an EMA sell percentage check. It has a -10% stoploss, trailing stop, and staged minimal ROI targets.

families.name: RSI
families.idea_html: RSI: Buys when RSI is below 30 and Williams %R is below -80. Sells when the 30-minute RSI is above 70 and the 30-minute Williams %R is above -20. Timeframe 15m with a -99% stoploss and a 9% minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15-minute candles, it buys when RSI is below 30 and Williams %R is below -80, and both conditions were also true on the previous candle. It sells when the 30-minute RSI is above 70 and the 30-minute Williams %R is above -20, again requiring both on the previous candle. It uses a minimal ROI of 0.01 and a stoploss of -0.99, with no trailing stop.

families.name: RSIResample
families.idea_html: RSIResampleV2: On the 5m timeframe the strategy buys when RSI is below 45 and the close is under a 4-period SMA, i.e. after price has weakened. It exits when RSI rises above 65. It uses a -25% stoploss, a trailing stop and a tiered ROI target of 5% falling to 1%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe the strategy buys when RSI is below a trigger level, below its own long-term minimum SMA minus 5, and the close is under a 4-period SMA, while rsi_max must stay under 85 and under its long-term SMA to avoid buying after big pumps. It sells when RSI is above 65 and at or above the max SMA, with volume lower than the previous bar. A custom stoploss hook is present, with no trailing stop.

families.name: RSI_MFI
families.idea_html: RSI_MFI: On the 5m timeframe the strategy buys when RSI is at or below a configurable level, MFI is at or below its own level, and the 8-period ROC is at most -1. It exits when RSI and MFI are at or above their sell thresholds and ROC is at least 1. Stoploss is -0.99 with no trailing stop and a flat 10 minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5-minute timeframe, it buys when RSI is at or below its buy threshold, MFI is at or below its buy threshold, ROC is at or below -1, and volume is above zero. It sells when RSI and MFI are at or above their sell thresholds and ROC is at or above 1, with volume above zero. It uses a minimal ROI of 10 and a stoploss of -0.99, with no trailing stop.

families.name: SAR
families.idea_html: SAR: On the 5m timeframe, the strategy buys when SAR flips below close, with the previous SAR above close, and volume is positive. It sells when SAR flips above close with volume, and it uses minimal ROI steps plus a -0.10 stoploss without trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Sar trades 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI crosses above 30, TEMA is below the Bollinger middle band and rising, and volume is positive. It exits when RSI crosses above 70 while TEMA is above the middle band and falling; stoploss is -10% and no trailing stop is used.

families.name: SARCross
families.idea_html: SARCross: On the configured timeframe, the strategy enters when SAR crosses below TEMA, with optional conditions on ADX, directional movement, MFI, Fisher RSI, Bollinger gain, and volume. It exits on the opposite SAR/TEMA cross unless a hold flag disables selling, with stoploss, trailing stop, and timeframe inherited from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, the strategy enters when SAR crosses below TEMA, with optional conditions on ADX, directional movement, MFI, Fisher RSI, Bollinger gain, and volume. It exits on the opposite SAR/TEMA cross unless a hold flag disables selling, with stoploss, trailing stop, and timeframe inherited from Config.

families.name: SMAOPv1_TTF
families.idea_html: SMAOPv1_TTF: On the 5m timeframe, the strategy buys when close is below an EMA buy offset and either EWO is above a high threshold with RSI below a buy level, or EWO is below a low threshold; volume must be positive. It exits when close is above an EMA sell offset or when TTF crosses above its upper trigger, with a -0.5 stoploss and no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, the strategy buys when close is below an EMA buy offset and either EWO is above a high threshold with RSI below a buy level, or EWO is below a low threshold; volume must be positive. It exits when close is above an EMA sell offset or when TTF crosses above its upper trigger, with a -0.5 stoploss and no trailing stop.

families.name: SampleStrategy
families.idea_html: SampleStrategy: On 5m candles, it enters long when RSI crosses above a buy threshold, TEMA is below the Bollinger middle band, and TEMA is rising; it enters short when RSI crosses above a short threshold, TEMA is above the middle band, and TEMA is falling. It exits long when RSI crosses above a sell threshold, TEMA is above the middle band, and TEMA is falling. It has a -0.10 stoploss, minimal ROI tiers, and can_short is False.

other_descriptions.idea_html: SampleStrategyV2 trades 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI crosses above a buy threshold, the trend direction is positive, TEMA is below the Bollinger middle band and rising, and volume is positive. It exits when RSI crosses above a sell threshold while TEMA is above the middle band and falling, with minimal ROI, a -20% stoploss, and trailing stop enabled.

families.name: Saturn
families.idea_html: Saturn5: Saturn5 trades 15-minute candles and has three optional long setups. It buys dips when price is below long EMAs or lower Bollinger/fib bands, or when shorter EMAs cross up while price is below the long EMA; it does not use sell signals and exits via a 5% ROI or -20% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Saturn5_1 trades 15-minute candles and has three optional long setups. It buys dips when price is below long EMAs or lower Bollinger/fib bands, or when shorter EMAs cross up while the close is above the long EMA but the low is below it; it does not use sell signals and exits via a 5% ROI or -20% stoploss.

families.name: SaulusStrategia
families.idea_html: SaulusStrategia: SaulusStrategia uses 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is less than EMA5. It exits when RSI is above 50 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is greater than EMA5, with a 1% minimal ROI and -10% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: SaulusStrategiaOtimizeHyperOpt uses 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is less than EMA5. It exits when RSI is above 50 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is greater than EMA5, with a stepped minimal ROI ladder and -27.8% stoploss.

families.name: ScalpingCCI
families.idea_html: ScalpingCCI: The timeframe is not specified. It enters long when close is above the 20-period EMA, MACD crosses above its signal line, and close is above the daily pivot, bc, and tc levels while those levels are rising versus 97 bars ago. It exits when open is at or above 98% of the daily high or when MACD crosses below its signal line, with a -0.04 stoploss and a stepped minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The timeframe is not specified. It enters long when close is above the 20-period EMA, MACD crosses above its signal line, and close is above the daily pivot, bc, and tc levels while those levels are rising versus 97 bars ago. It exits when open is at or above 98% of the daily high or when MACD crosses below its signal line, with a -0.04 stoploss and a stepped minimal ROI.

families.name: SchismLess
families.idea_html: SchismLess: On the 15m timeframe, it enters long when the informative RSI is below a threshold and RMI slow/fast and mp are below thresholds while RMI is in a downtrend. If already in a trade, it can add when RMI is in an uptrend and profit conditions are met. The sell signal is disabled, so exits are handled by the -0.20 stoploss and the ROI table, though the inactive sell code uses a loss cutoff and RMI crosses below 50 or 10.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when close is near the 3-day low plus a fraction of ADR, informative RSI is above a threshold, and RMI slow/fast and mp are below thresholds while RMI is in a downtrend. If already in a trade, it can add when RMI is in an uptrend and profit conditions are met. The sell signal is enabled, and exits use a loss cutoff, RMI crosses below 50 or 10, a -0.40 stoploss, and the ROI table.

families.name: Schism_Badstreak
families.idea_html: Schism_Badstreak: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when mp is below a threshold, streak-roc is above the PCC lower band, and the mac moving-average cross condition equals 1. If already in a trade, it can add when RMI is in an uptrend and profit conditions are met. The sell signal is disabled, so exits are handled by the -0.20 stoploss and ROI table, with an inactive sell code using loss cutoff and RMI crosses.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 15m timeframe, it enters long when either informative RSI and mp are below thresholds with streak-roc above the PCC lower band and mac equals 1, or informative RSI is below a threshold with RMI in an uptrend and rmi between two thresholds. If already in a trade, it can add when RMI is in an uptrend and profit conditions are met. The sell signal is disabled, so exits are handled by the -0.30 stoploss and ROI table, with an inactive sell code using loss cutoff and RMI crosses.

families.name: SeeYouLater
families.idea_html: SeeYouLaterTSL: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when the bearish fractal pattern is active, close is below the Alligator teeth, and volume is positive. It exits when the bullish fractal pattern is active, close is above the Alligator teeth, and volume is positive. It has a -0.99 stoploss, trailing_stop is False, and a stepped minimal ROI table.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, this strategy computes Alligator lips/jaw/teeth and fractal-like bearish/bullish conditions from shifted highs and lows. It buys when the bearish condition is true, close is below the Alligator teeth, and volume is positive, and it sells when the bullish condition is true, close is above teeth, and volume is positive. It uses a -0.2 stoploss and a decaying minimal ROI, with trailing stop disabled.

families.name: SimpleBollinger
families.idea_html: SimpleBollinger: Timeframe is set from Config. It computes ADX, MFI, MACD, stochastic, RSI, Fisher RSI, Bollinger bands on typical price, EMAs, SAR, and SMA. Entry is a close crossing above the upper Bollinger band, with optional ADX, MFI, and MACD conditions depending on enabled flags. Exit is a close crossing below the lower Bollinger band with an optional MFI condition, or sell signals are suppressed when sell_hold is enabled.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Timeframe and use_sell_signal come from Config. It computes ADX, MFI, MACD, stochastic, RSI, Fisher RSI, Bollinger bands on typical price, EMAs, SAR, and SMA. Entry is a close crossing above the upper Bollinger band, with optional ADX, MFI, and MACD conditions depending on enabled flags. Exit is a close crossing below the lower Bollinger band with an optional MFI condition, or sell signals are suppressed when sell_hold is enabled.

families.name: SimpleHopt
families.idea_html: SimpleHopt: On a 5m timeframe, it uses fixed MACD, RSI periods from a parameter range, and Bollinger bands. It buys when MACD is above zero and above signal, the upper Bollinger band is rising, and the selected RSI is above the buy threshold. It exits when the selected RSI is above the sell threshold, with a -0.25 stoploss and 1% minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1d timeframe, this strategy can short. It uses fixed MACD, a selected RSI period from a range, and Bollinger bands. It enters short when MACD is below zero and below signal, the upper Bollinger band is declining, and the selected RSI is below the short-buy threshold. It exits short when the selected RSI is above the sell-short threshold, with a -0.10 stoploss and 1% minimal ROI.

families.name: SlopeIsDope
families.idea_html: SlopeIsDope: On the 4h timeframe, it computes 200/50/21/3 SMAs, slopes of the 21 and 50 SMAs, RSI, and a shifted 10-bar low. Entry requires close above the 200 SMA, positive fast and slow slopes, close above its value 11 bars ago, RSI above 55, and fast SMA above slow SMA. Exit uses fast SMA below slow SMA or close below the previous 10-bar low; stoploss is -90%, trailing stop is off, and ROI is 60%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 4-hour timeframe the entry requires close above a 200-period SMA, positive fast and slow MA slopes, close above a shifted 3-period SMA, RSI(7) above 55 and the fast MA above the slow MA. The long exits when the fast MA falls below the slow MA or the close drops under the prior 10-bar lowest low. Trailing stop is enabled with a 60% minimal ROI and a -90% stoploss.

families.name: SlowPotato
families.idea_html: SlowPotato: On 5m candles, it buys when the low is at or below the rolling 1440-candle average low and volume is positive. It sells when the high is at or above the rolling 1440-candle average high with positive volume, and trailing stop is enabled. Minimal ROI is effectively disabled and stoploss is -99%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys when the rolling 288-candle average low is below the rolling 288-candle average high, the low is at or below that average low, and volume is positive. The sell signal is disabled and the exit code sets sell to 0, so exits come from the ROI schedule and -17.1% stoploss. Trailing stop is off.

families.name: SmartMoneyStrategy
families.idea_html: SmartMoneyStrategy: On 30m candles, it uses Chaikin Money Flow, MFI, and a 200-period EMA. It buys when close is below the EMA200, MFI is below 35, and CMF is below -0.07, and sells when close is above EMA200, MFI is above 70, and CMF is above 0.20. Stoploss is -100% and minimal ROI is 1000%, so exits are mainly signal-based.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1h candles, it uses Chaikin Money Flow, MFI, and a 200-period EMA with hyperopt parameter thresholds. It buys when close is below EMA200, MFI is below the buy threshold, and CMF is below the buy threshold, and sells when close is above EMA200, MFI is above the sell threshold, and CMF is above the sell threshold. Stoploss is -100% and minimal ROI is 1000%.

families.name: StrategyAnalysis
families.idea_html: StrategyAnalysis: The fact sheet contains no class attributes, indicators, entry, or exit code. No trading logic can be identified from the provided sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet contains only class/hook placeholders and empty indicator, entry, and exit sections. No trading logic, timeframe, or parameters are provided.

families.name: SuperReversal_mtf
families.idea_html: SuperReversal_mtf: A 15m long/short strategy that reads a 1h SuperTrend direction and 1h EMA alignment as the trend state, then enters when the 15m candle straddles the 1h short EMA (high above it, low below it). Longs need SuperTrend direction 1 and short EMA above long EMA; shorts need direction -1 and short EMA below long EMA. Exits fire when the SuperTrend direction or the EMA alignment flips while the candle still straddles the short EMA. Stoploss is -0.75 and the ROI table has a single 500% target.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The fact sheet contains only the class attribute timeframe = '5m'; there is no indicator code, entry code or exit code to read. No trading logic can be described from the sheet.

families.name: SuperTrendPure
families.idea_html: SuperTrendPure: A 1h strategy that computes a SuperTrend line with a 2/8 setting and buys when close crosses above it, provided volume is greater than zero. It sells when close crosses below the SuperTrend line. Risk is managed with a trailing stop and a -0.265 stoploss plus a stepped ROI table from 8.7% down to 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: A 1h strategy that computes a SuperTrend line with a 2/8 setting and enters long when close crosses above it with non-zero volume. It exits when close crosses below the SuperTrend line. Risk is managed with a trailing stop, a -0.265 stoploss and a stepped ROI table from 8.7% down to 0.

families.name: SupertrendStrategy
families.idea_html: SupertrendStrategy: A 1h strategy that builds three SuperTrend indicators (20/3.0, 20/4.0, 40/8.0) and buys when their direction sum is at least 1, stochastic RSI is below a configurable buy threshold, close is above EMA90 and volume is non-zero. The sell signal requires the SuperTrend direction sum to be below 1 and stochastic RSI above a configurable sell level. The ROI table is inactive and the stoploss is set to -0.99.

other_descriptions.idea_html: A 1h strategy using three SuperTrend variants (20/3.0, 20/4.0, 40/8.0); it buys when at least one direction is bullish, stochastic RSI is below the configured buy level, close is above EMA90 and volume is non-zero. Exits occur when the summed SuperTrend direction drops below 1 and stochastic RSI is above the configured sell level. The ROI table is inactive and the stoploss is -0.99.

families.name: TEMABounce
families.idea_html: TEMABounce: On the configured timeframe, the strategy uses TEMA long/short and TEMA slope indicators; it enters when TEMA difference is positive and the TEMA slope crosses above zero, optionally filtered by MACD histogram and Bollinger gain, and exits when the TEMA slope crosses below zero while price is above the long TEMA and the TEMA difference is not too negative, unless sell_hold is set. Stoploss and ROI come from Config.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the configured timeframe, the strategy uses TEMA long/short and TEMA slope indicators; it enters when TEMA difference is positive and the TEMA slope crosses above zero, optionally filtered by MACD histogram and Bollinger gain, and exits when the TEMA slope crosses below zero while price is above the long TEMA and the TEMA difference is not too negative, unless sell_hold is set. Stoploss and ROI come from Config.

families.name: TRIWAVE
families.idea_html: TRIWAVE: On a 15m timeframe, the strategy computes 2h informative RSI and Wave CI indicators and enters when auto_buy_decision crosses above the auto_buy threshold. It exits when auto_sell_decision is at or above the auto_sell threshold. It has position adjustment enabled with max_entry_position_adjustment = 0, a stoploss of -0.25, and a minimal ROI of 0.215.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 15m timeframe with 2h informative data, this strategy calculates WaveTrend-style oscillator values (wave_ci, wave_t1, wave_t2) and informative RSI. It enters long when auto_buy_decision crosses above a configured buy value (or above the buy value plus a bearzzz offset) and exits when auto_sell_decision reaches a configured sell value. It uses a -25% stoploss, 21.5% minimal ROI, volume > 0 filter, and position adjustment/custom stoploss hooks.

families.name: TaSearchDynamic30m
families.idea_html: TaSearchDynamic30m: On 30m, it computes search extremes, buy_past_rsi, and buy_stride. Entry requires buy_stride between -1 and 10, buy_past_rsi > -1, and market == -1; exit is when rsi_7 > 85 or rsi_7 > 70 with rsi_30 > 62. It has a 5% minimal ROI and -2% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 30m timeframe, the entry requires buy_stride to be between 4 and 10 and buy_past_rsi to be above 2, both produced by helper functions not shown in the sheet. It exits when rsi_7 is above 85 or rsi_30 is above 75. The class sets minimal_roi to 0.1 and stoploss to -0.0.

families.name: TaSearchDynamic5m
families.idea_html: TaSearchDynamic5m: On a 5m timeframe, entry requires buy_stride between -1 and 10, buy_past_rsi above -1, and market equal to -1, using custom helper columns. It exits when rsi_7 is above 75 or rsi_30 is above 60. The strategy has a stoploss of -0.02 and tiered minimal_roi values starting at 0.02.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, entry requires buy_stride between 3 and 8 and buy_past_rsi above 0, after helper functions build the signals; it returns early if zero-volume candles are present in the recent sample. It exits when rsi_7 is above 88 or rsi_30 is above 73. The class sets stoploss -0.02 and minimal_roi steps at 0.05 and 0.02.

families.name: TaSearchLevelH15m
families.idea_html: TaSearchLevelH15m: The strategy can short and uses helper functions do_heikin_ashi, do_long and do_short to create buy_long, buy_long2, buy_short and buy_short2 signals. Entry fires when those custom signals are above zero, opening long or short. Exit closes shorts when rsi_7 is below 10 and longs when rsi_7 is above 90. No timeframe is specified in the sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 15m timeframe, the strategy can short and uses helper functions do_heikin_ashi, do_long and do_short to create buy_long, buy_long2, buy_short and buy_short2 signals. Entry fires when those custom signals are above zero, opening long or short. Exit closes shorts when rsi_7 is below 10 and longs when rsi_7 is above 90; stoploss is -0.25 and minimal_roi is 100.0.

families.name: Tank5Hurst
families.idea_html: Tank5HurstDCAV1: On a 5m timeframe, the strategy uses configurable 'Full Send' long entry blocks built from envelope, cycle, oscillator, signal and volume conditions; one block requires lower_envelope_h1 to be above close. Exits are profit-taker blocks that compare signal and harmonic levels against envelopes. Position adjustment, custom entry price and custom stoploss hooks are present, with stoploss -0.99 and no minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, long entries are gated by configurable 'Full Send' blocks combining envelope, cycle, dominant_cycle, signal and volume conditions; full_send1 requires lower_envelope_h1 above close. Exits are profit-taker blocks using signal and harmonic levels relative to envelopes. Position adjustment and custom entry/stoploss hooks are enabled, with stoploss -0.99 and no minimal ROI.

families.name: Tank5Modulus
families.idea_html: Tank5ModulusDCA: On a 5m timeframe, entry uses configurable 'Full Send' blocks; several require minima_check and wave_t1 below wave_t1_DN_FIB, while another requires move above its mean and OHLC4 below the 200 SMA. Exits use maxima_check and wave_t1 above wave_t1_UP_FIB. Position adjustment and custom entry/stoploss hooks are enabled, with stoploss -0.99 and no minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, entries use configurable 'Full Send' long blocks that require bullish divergences and Williams %R below -50 or -85, often with price below the 200 SMA or below Fibonacci wave levels. Exits use bearish divergences, Williams %R above -50 or -15, and AlphaTrend distance or Fibonacci wave conditions. Position adjustment and custom entry/stoploss hooks are enabled, with stoploss -0.99 and no minimal ROI.

families.name: TechnicalExampleStrategy
families.idea_html: TechnicalExampleStrategy: On a 5m timeframe, the strategy buys when the 21-period Chaikin Money Flow (cmf) is below zero and exits when cmf is above zero. It has a minimal_roi of 0.01 and a stoploss of -0.05.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Uses a 21-period Chaikin Money Flow (CMF) indicator. Enters long when CMF is below zero and exits when CMF rises above zero. No timeframe is specified; it uses minimal ROI and a stoploss.

families.name: Test
families.idea_html: Test4: Buys when the 2-bar rolling maximum open compared with close, divided by close, exceeds a dip threshold and volume is positive. Exits when EMA9 crosses below EMA21 while close is above EMA200 and volume is positive. No timeframe is specified; uses trailing stop and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it can enter long and short using daily pivot, support, and resistance levels plus RSI. Long entries are tagged Failed-Breakdown and short entries Failed-Breakup, and exits are tagged Pivot-TP. The actual entry and exit conditions are inside helper methods that are not shown in the fact sheet. It uses a custom stoploss and ROI.

families.name: TheRealPullback
families.idea_html: TheRealPullbackV2: On 5-minute candles, the indicator code builds an is_dip condition from oversold RMI, CCI, Stochastic RSI, MFI, and Chaikin Money Flow, plus an is_break condition from Bollinger band width above 0.025 and a lower-band cross rolling window. Entry fires when buy_signal is positive. Exits occur when close crosses below the Bollinger middle band or upper band. It uses a -3.5% stoploss and minimal ROI set to 100.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles, the indicator code builds an is_dip condition from oversold RMI, CCI, Stochastic RSI, MFI, and Chaikin Money Flow, plus an is_break condition from Bollinger band width above 0.025 and a lower-band cross rolling window. Entry fires when buy_signal is positive. Exits occur when close crosses below the Bollinger middle band or upper band. It uses a -3.5% stoploss and minimal ROI set to 100.

families.name: Trader
families.idea_html: Trader_4: On 5-minute candles, it enters long when RSI slow is falling, fast RSI is below a threshold, RSI is above a threshold, close is below SMA15 multiplied by a factor, and CTI is below a threshold. The exit trend signal is set to zero, so exits are managed by the custom_exit hook and the -25% stoploss with trailing stop. Minimal ROI is set to 1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles, it enters long when RSI slow is falling, fast RSI is below a threshold, RSI is above a threshold, close is below SMA15 multiplied by a factor, and CTI is below a threshold. The exit trend signal is set to zero, so exits are managed by the custom_exit hook and the -25% stoploss with trailing stop. Minimal ROI is set to 1.

families.name: TrailingBuyStratCluc
families.idea_html: TrailingBuyStratCluc: This is a trailing-buy wrapper that calls the base strategy's buy logic. In live or dry-run it starts a trailing buy when the base buy signal appears and can force a buy while trailing is active. The actual entry signal comes from the superclass and is not shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1m timeframe with a -0.99 stoploss and custom_stoploss hook, it computes Heikin-Ashi candles, Bollinger Bands on Heikin-Ashi typical price, EMAs, ROCR, RSI, Fisher, and a 1h informative ROCR. It enters long when the 1h ROCR is above a threshold and either Heikin-Ashi close is below the shifted lower band with delta/tail conditions or below the slow EMA and a scaled lower band. The sell rule exits when the Fisher transform is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes are falling, and price is above the middle band.

families.name: TrailingBuyStratClucBBRPBMODE
families.idea_html: TrailingBuyStratClucBBRPBMODE: This is a trailing-buy wrapper that calls the base strategy's buy logic. In live or dry-run it starts a trailing buy when the base buy signal appears and can force a buy while trailing is active. The actual entry signal comes from the superclass and is not shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1m timeframe with a -0.99 stoploss and custom_stoploss hook, it builds Heikin-Ashi candles, EMAs, RSIs, stochastic, ADX, CTI, and Bollinger Bands. The visible entry conditions are two 'lambo' dip-buy rules requiring close below an EMA factor and RSI below limits, gated by BTC safety and pump filters. The sell rule exits when the Fisher transform is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes are falling, and price is above the middle band.

families.name: TrailingBuy_ClucHAnix_5m_E0V1E_by_TraNz
families.idea_html: TrailingBuy_ClucHAnix_5m_E0V1E_by_TraNz: On a 5m timeframe with a -0.99 stoploss and custom_stoploss hook, it computes Heikin-Ashi candles, Bollinger Bands on Heikin-Ashi typical price, EMAs, ROCR, RSI, Fisher, and a 1h informative ROCR. It enters long when the 1h ROCR is above a threshold and either Heikin-Ashi close is below the shifted lower band with delta/tail conditions or below the slow EMA and a scaled lower band. The sell rule exits when the Fisher transform is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes are falling, and price is above the middle band.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe with a -0.99 stoploss and custom_stoploss hook, it computes Heikin-Ashi candles, Bollinger Bands on Heikin-Ashi typical price, EMAs, ROCR, RSI, Fisher, and a 1h informative ROCR. It enters long when the 1h ROCR is above a threshold and either Heikin-Ashi close is below the shifted lower band with delta/tail conditions or below the slow EMA and a scaled lower band. The sell rule exits when the Fisher transform is high, Heikin-Ashi highs and closes are falling, and price is above the middle band.

families.name: Trend_Strength_Directional
families.idea_html: Trend_Strength_Directional: On 15m candles, it buys when +DI is above -DI and ADX is above the buy threshold. It sells when +DI is below -DI and ADX is below the sell threshold. It uses a -0.314 stoploss and trailing stop with stepped minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m candles, it buys when +DI is above -DI and ADX is above the buy threshold. It exits when +DI is below -DI and ADX is below the sell threshold. It uses a -0.314 stoploss and trailing stop with stepped minimal ROI.

families.name: Trend_grid
families.idea_html: Trend_grid: On 5m candles, it triggers long when slow RSI is falling, fast RSI is below a threshold, RSI is above a threshold, close is below SMA15 times a parameter, and CTI is below a threshold; short triggers are the mirror. Exit signals are not defined in the shown code (use_exit_signal=False). It enables position adjustment up to 4 additional entries, has extreme minimal ROI/stoploss values, and uses leverage.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it triggers long when slow RSI is falling, fast RSI is below a threshold, RSI is above a threshold, close is below SMA15 times a parameter, and CTI is below a threshold; short triggers are the mirror. Exit signals are not defined in the shown code (use_exit_signal=False). It enables position adjustment up to 4 additional entries, has minimal ROI 0.8 and stoploss -0.8, and uses leverage.

families.name: ViNBuyPct
families.idea_html: ViNBuyPct: ViNBuyPct enters long using a loop over lookback ranges and custom conditions based on candle counts, volume, streak metrics, pctchange ratios against Bollinger band pctchange, and a ratio of lc2_adj to close. The indicator code is empty, so the custom columns are not defined in the fact sheet. No exit code is shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This strategy scans many lookback windows, computes rolling mean and standard deviation of percentage change, and enters when the current pct-change is just above the lower band, the band width is at least 0.02, volume is elevated, and short-term streaks are negative. It also requires lc2_adj/close between 0.975 and 0.995. The sheet shows no exit code or class attributes, so no timeframe, stoploss, or exit rule is specified.

families.name: VolatilitySystem
families.idea_html: VolatilitySystem: On 1h, it resamples to a 3h interval, computes ATR(14)*2 and the 3h close change. It enters long when the 3h close change exceeds the previous ATR, and the code also defines the opposite short entry, though can_short is False. Exits are the opposite entry signal; ROI and stoploss are effectively disabled.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1h, it resamples to a 3h interval, computes ATR(14)*2 and the 3h close change. It enters long when the 3h close change exceeds the previous ATR and enters short when the negative close change exceeds it. Exits are the opposite entry signal; ROI and stoploss are effectively disabled.

families.name: WaveTrendStra
families.idea_html: WaveTrendStra: On 4h, it computes WaveTrend wt1 and its 4-period SMA wt2. It buys when wt1 crosses above wt2 and sells when wt1 crosses below wt2. ROI is disabled and stoploss is -25%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 4h, it computes WaveTrend, RSI, MACD, volume EMA and ATR. It buys when WaveTrend wt1 crosses above wt2 while RSI > 50, MACD > signal, volume > volume EMA, ATR > its mean, and ADX > 25. It sells on the opposite WaveTrend cross; a ROI ladder, -26.9% stoploss, and trailing stop are set.

families.name: XebTradeStrat
families.idea_html: XebTradeStrat: On 1m, it computes EMA5 and EMA10. It buys when EMA5 crosses above EMA10 on positive volume; there is no sell signal, so exits come from ROI, the -1% stoploss, or trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1m, it computes EMA5 and EMA10. It buys when EMA5 crosses above EMA10 on positive volume; there is no sell signal, so exits come from the 0.99 ROI target, the -5% stoploss, or trailing stop.

families.name: YorganStrategy
families.idea_html: YorganStrategy: On 5m, it builds EMAs for buy and sell ranges, HMA50, SMA9, EWO, RSI, fast RSI and slow RSI. It buys when fast RSI is below 35, price is below a buy EMA offset, RSI is below a buy threshold, and an EWO condition is met, with an additional lower-RSI buy variant. It sells on strength conditions, using a -10% stoploss and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it builds EMAs for buy and sell ranges, HMA50, SMA9, EWO, RSI, fast RSI and slow RSI. It buys when fast RSI is below 35, price is below a buy EMA offset, RSI is below a buy threshold, and an EWO condition is met, with an additional lower-RSI buy variant. It sells on strength conditions, using a -10% stoploss and trailing stop.

families.name: ZarTest
families.idea_html: ZarTest: On the 5m timeframe, this strategy can go long or short. It enters long when DX, ADX and PDI are all above MDI, or when the close crosses above the upper Bollinger band; it enters short when DX and ADX are above PDI and MDI is above PDI, or when the close crosses below the lower Bollinger band. Exits are driven by opposing long/short signals and it uses a trailing stop with stoploss -0.296 and no minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe, this strategy can go long or short. It enters long when DX, ADX and PDI are all above MDI, or when the close crosses above the upper Bollinger band; it enters short when DX and ADX are above PDI and MDI is above PDI, or when the close crosses below the lower Bollinger band. Exits close shorts on long DI or upper Bollinger signals and close longs on short DI or lower Bollinger signals; it uses a trailing stop with stoploss -0.296 and no minimal ROI.

families.name: abydon_wbtc
families.idea_html: abydon_wbtc: A 3m strategy that opens a long whenever the candle open is below 1.0025 and closes it when the close is above 1.0025; MACD, RSI, SAR and SMA are computed but not used in the rules.
