There is no trailing stop and the stoploss is -0.99, so exits come from the fixed price threshold or the ROI table.

other_descriptions.idea_html: A 3m strategy that opens a long whenever the close is below 1.0025 and closes it when the close is above 1.0025; MACD, RSI, SAR and SMA are computed but not used in the rules. There is no trailing stop and the stoploss is -0.99, so exits come from the fixed price threshold or the ROI table.

families.name: adaptive
families.idea_html: adaptive: A 5m long strategy that buys after a drop: KAMA above FAMA, FAMA near MAMA, Williams %R below -61.3, negative mama_diff, CTI below -0.715, close at least 5% below the 48-bar high and 12.5% below the 288-bar high, with both slow RSIs under 60. The sell block is empty, so positions close through the 2% ROI target or the -10.9% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: A 5m long strategy that buys after a drop: KAMA above FAMA, FAMA near MAMA, Williams %R below -61.3, negative mama_diff, CTI below -0.715, close at least 5% below the 48-bar high and 12.5% below the 288-bar high, with both slow RSIs under 60. The sell block is empty, so positions close through the 2% ROI target or the -10.9% stoploss.

families.name: adxMomentum
families.idea_html: adxMomentum: A long entry triggers when ADX is above 25, momentum is negative, minus DI is above 25 and above plus DI, i.e. buying into a bearish, strong-trend reading. The sell rule mirrors it with positive momentum and plus DI dominance above minus DI. No timeframe is stated in the sheet; exits come from the 1% ROI target or the -25% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: A long entry triggers when ADX is above 25, momentum is negative, minus DI is above 25 and above plus DI, i.e. buying into a bearish, strong-trend reading. The sell rule mirrors it with positive momentum and plus DI dominance above minus DI. No timeframe is stated in the sheet; exits come from the 1% ROI target or the -25% stoploss.

families.name: bollinger
families.idea_html: bollinger: Buys when close crosses above the upper Bollinger band and sells when close crosses below the 70-period EMA. The Bollinger bands use a 70-period window with 2 standard deviations. It has a 0.2 minimal ROI and a -0.10 stoploss; no timeframe is given.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Buys when close crosses below the lower Bollinger band and sells when close crosses above the upper Bollinger band. The bands use a 20-period window and 3 standard deviations. It has an empty minimal ROI and a -0.10 stoploss; no timeframe is given.

families.name: brawbot
families.idea_html: brawbot: On a 5m timeframe, it buys when the 48h high-low range is under 8%, the short EMA is above the long EMA, close is above the short EMA, RSI is above a buy threshold, and volume is 20% above its 10-period mean. The shown populate_sell_trend returns no sell signal, so exits are left to the custom_stoploss hook and ROI/stoploss settings. It has a -0.10 stoploss and a time-based minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it buys when the 5m close trend is above the 15m trend EMA (EMA3), after checking should_allow_new_trades. Exit triggers when the 5m close trend crosses below the configured sell trend indicator. It uses a trailing stop, a -0.275 stoploss, and a stepped minimal ROI.

families.name: brideofcluckie
families.idea_html: brideofcluckie: On a 5m timeframe, it uses Heikin-Ashi close and Bollinger bands on Heikin-Ashi typical price. Buys require go_long > 0 plus either a BinHV45-style drop below the prior lower band with candle-body/tail filters, or a ClucMay72018-style drop below EMA50 and the lower band with low volume. Exit is when Heikin-Ashi close times a factor is above the Bollinger middle band; it has a small ROI ladder, -0.10 stoploss, and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it merges 1H and 15M informative data and requires go_long, go_long_avg, and SSL high filters before the buy conditions. The buy trigger is the same BinHV45 or ClucMay72018 mean-reversion setup: Heikin-Ashi close below the prior lower band, or below EMA50 and the lower band with low volume. Exit is when Heikin-Ashi close times a factor is above the Bollinger middle band; it has a small ROI ladder, -0.99 stoploss, and trailing stop.

families.name: chatgpt
families.idea_html: chatgpt: On a 1h timeframe, it enters long when Schaff Trend Cycle is above a threshold, CCI is above a threshold, and Williams %R is below a buy level. It exits when STC is below the threshold, CCI is below the threshold, and Williams %R is above a sell level. It uses a -0.75 stoploss and a 500 minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 15m timeframe, it can go long and short. Long entry triggers when RSI crosses above buy_rsi, TEMA is at or below the Bollinger middle band and rising; short entry triggers when RSI crosses above short_rsi, TEMA is above the middle band and falling. Exits also use RSI crosses, and the sheet shows a trailing stop, -0.10 stoploss, and stepped minimal ROI.

families.name: cqq_Green_5m
families.idea_html: cqq_Green_5mv2: On a 5m timeframe, it uses BTC informative data, several EMAs, HMA50, SMA9, EWO, and RSI. Entries include a lambo2 dip below EMA14 with low RSI4/RSI14, plus EWO-based rules requiring fast RSI below 35, close below a buy MA offset, and positive volume. Exit logic uses HMA50, sell MA offsets, RSI, and fast/slow RSI comparisons; it has a 100 minimal ROI, -0.25 stoploss, trailing stop, and position-adjustment hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m timeframe, it enters long on dip conditions such as close below an EMA factor with RSI and RSI_fast below limits, plus EWO/RSI-based conditions. Exits use HMA50 and MA offset with RSI conditions, and the strategy uses custom stoploss, custom exit, trailing stop, and adjust_trade_position hooks. minimal_roi is set to 100 and stoploss is -0.08.

families.name: crossAboveStrategy
families.idea_html: crossAboveStrategy: On 5m timeframe, it enters long when the candle mean is at or above EMA100 and has crossed above EMA100 within the last three bars, while Bollinger bands are not collapsed. Exits occur when close is at or above the upper Bollinger band and RSI is above its 300-period nearest-rank 80th percentile. Stoploss is -0.2 and a custom_stoploss hook is present.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m timeframe, it enters long when the candle mean is at or above EMA100 with a recent cross above EMA100, RSI is below its 300-period nearest-rank 50th percentile, and Bollinger bands are not collapsed. Exits occur when close is at or above the upper Bollinger band and RSI is above its 300-period nearest-rank 80th percentile. Stoploss is -0.2 and a custom_stoploss hook is present.

families.name: dualwave
families.idea_html: dualwave: This 15-minute strategy enters long when auto_buy_decision crosses above a configured threshold, with a second lower-threshold variant. It exits when auto_sell_decision reaches a configured level, and it uses a -0.25 stoploss with a 0.215 minimal ROI. It declares position-adjustment and custom-stoploss hooks, but the auto signal definition is not shown.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15-minute candles it enters long when auto_buy_decision and its 1-hour counterpart exceed thresholds, the local signal is not falling, and 200-period SMA slopes agree with the variant direction. Exits occur when auto_sell_decision crosses configured levels, gated by 1-hour 200-SMA slope. It uses a -0.25 stoploss, 0.215 minimal ROI, and position-adjustment hooks.

families.name: el
families.idea_html: el: This 5-minute strategy goes long when close is below a configurable buy EMA by a low offset, either with EWO above a high level and RSI below a threshold, or with EWO below a low level. It goes short when close is above a sell EMA by a high offset. Longs exit on that high-offset sell-EMA condition, shorts exit on the buy conditions, with trailing stop and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5-minute candles it enters long when close is below a configurable entry EMA by a low offset, with either EWO above a high level and RSI below a threshold, or EWO below a low level. It enters short when close is above an exit EMA by a high offset. Longs exit on the high-offset exit-EMA condition, and shorts exit on the entry-EMA dip conditions, with trailing stop and a tight ROI.

families.name: eltoro
families.idea_html: eltoro: This 15-minute strategy enters long when auto_buy_decision crosses above a threshold and BTC 1-hour EWO is above a bull level, or with a lower threshold when BTC EWO is below that level. It exits when auto_sell_decision reaches its configured level. It has a -0.25 stoploss, 0.215 ROI target, and position-adjustment hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1-hour candles it enters long when auto_buy_decision exceeds a threshold and BTC 4-hour EWO is above or below a bull level, with rising or falling EWO selecting the variant. Exits require auto_sell_decision to reach a threshold together with close below HMA_50 and a BTC EWO condition. It uses a -0.25 stoploss, 0.215 ROI target, and position-adjustment hooks.

families.name: f_supertrend_strategy
families.idea_html: f_supertrend_strategy: On a 1-hour timeframe, it enters long when three configured SuperTrend buy indicators are all up and volume is positive, and enters short when three configured SuperTrend sell indicators are all down and volume is positive. It exits long when the second sell SuperTrend indicator is down and exits short when the second buy SuperTrend indicator is up. It has a -26.5% stoploss and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 1-hour timeframe, it enters long when three configured SuperTrend buy indicators are all up and volume is positive, and enters short when three configured SuperTrend sell indicators are all down and volume is positive. It exits long when the second sell SuperTrend indicator is down and exits short when the second buy SuperTrend indicator is up. It has a -20% stoploss and trailing stop.

families.name: fa_m8_strategy
families.idea_html: fa_m8_strategy: On a 4-hour timeframe, it enters long when RSI is above 88 and the close is above a minimum coin price. It exits when RSI falls below 37 or the one-candle percentage price change is above 23%. It uses a -2.059% stoploss without trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 4-hour timeframe, it enters long when RSI satisfies a runtime direction parameter against a runtime buy threshold and the close is above a minimum price. It exits when RSI satisfies a runtime direction parameter against a sell threshold or when the one-candle percentage price change exceeds a runtime sell percentage. It uses a -27.7% stoploss without trailing stop.

families.name: fahmibah
families.idea_html: fahmibah: On a 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when Heikin-Ashi close is below a factored EMA14 and RSI(4) and RSI(14) are below configured limits, or under other lower-band and EMA dip conditions. It has no active sell signal and exits through ROI, stoploss, or custom stoploss. It uses a -10% stoploss.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5-minute timeframe, it enters long when Heikin-Ashi close is above EMA200 but below a factored lower Bollinger Band (20,2), or under other lower-band and EMA dip conditions. It has use_sell_signal set to False, so exits are handled by ROI, stoploss, or custom_stoploss. It uses a -10% stoploss.

families.name: fixed_riskreward_loss
families.idea_html: FixedRiskRewardLoss: It computes ATR and a stoploss_rate two ATRs below close, storing that series for custom_stoploss. The entry method sets buy=1 on every candle and the exit method sets sell=0, so there is no TA-based entry or exit rule. Class stoploss is -0.9.

other_descriptions.idea_html: The strategy computes ATR and stores a custom_info series of close minus 2*ATR as a stoploss rate for each pair. The buy column is set to 1 on every candle, so entries are unconditional, while the sell column is always 0. Exits are therefore left to a custom_stoploss hook that reads the stored ATR-based rate, despite the docstring mentioning SAR.

families.name: hacker_noon
families.idea_html: hacker_noon: It buys when RSI is below 20 and the close is under the lower Bollinger band, i.e. on weakness. The exit sells when the Fisher transform built from RSI rises above -0.13955. Stochastics, SAR and CDLHAMMER are computed but not used in either rule, and the stoploss is -0.30566.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Entry requires RSI below 29 while the close sits below the lower Bollinger band. The trade is closed when the RSI-derived Fisher transform exceeds 0.11938. A trailing stop is enabled and the stoploss is -0.33706; stochastics, SAR and CDLHAMMER are calculated but unused.

families.name: heikin
families.idea_html: heikin: On the 1h timeframe it builds Heikin-Ashi-style close, open, high and low columns and smooths the close and open series with 6-period SMAs. It buys while the smoothed open average is below the smoothed close average and sells when the open average rises above the close average. Minimal ROI is set flat at 10 and the stoploss is -0.99.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5m timeframe it enters when the close crosses above the hma16 line and the yasin1 line crosses above yasin, both derived from triple-MA smoothed Heikin-Ashi/ohlc4/hlc3 series. The sell rule computes the opposite yasin crossover but assigns 0 to the sell column, so signal exits are not used. Positions are closed by the minimal ROI table, a trailing stop and the -0.031 stoploss.

families.name: hodl
families.idea_html: hodl: It has no indicator or entry logic: every candle is marked as a buy and no sell signal is ever set. The stoploss is -1 and minimal ROI is set to 1000, so the position is effectively held. No timeframe is specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It has no indicator or entry logic: every candle is marked as a buy and no sell signal is ever set. The stoploss is -1 and minimal ROI is set to 1000, so the position is effectively held. No timeframe is specified.

families.name: indicator_mix
families.idea_html: indicator_mix: On the 5m timeframe, buy and sell signals are generated from dynamically created conditions based on configured indicator comparisons and grouping. No concrete entry or exit rule is visible in the sheet. It has a stepped minimal ROI and a stoploss of -0.25.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, it builds entry and exit conditions dynamically from configured buy and sell comparisons via self.iopt.create_conditions. The buy signal is set when the generated condition groups pass, and the sell signal when the generated sell conditions pass. It uses a 10%/5%/3%/0% ROI ladder and a -25% stoploss.

families.name: keltnerchannel
families.idea_html: keltnerchannel: On a 6h timeframe, it computes a 20-period Keltner channel with 1 ATR and RSI(14) with an hline at 55. It enters long when close crosses above the Keltner upper band and RSI is above hline; it exits when close crosses below the Keltner middle band. It uses a -0.254 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 100.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 6h timeframe, it computes a 16-period Keltner channel with 1 ATR and RSI(14) with an hline at 61. It enters long when close crosses above the Keltner upper band and RSI is above hline; it exits when close crosses below the Keltner middle band. It uses a -0.254 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 100.

families.name: main
families.idea_html: main: Buys when fast EMA is above slow EMA and RSI is below an oversold threshold, with BTC dominance below its moving average as a sentiment filter. Exits when fast EMA is below slow EMA and RSI is above an overbought threshold. Uses a 2% stoploss and trailing stop; timeframe is not specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Defines fast/slow EMA, RSI, and BTC dominance SMA. Buys when fast EMA is above slow EMA and RSI is below oversold, with BTC dominance below its moving average. Exits when fast EMA is below slow EMA and RSI is above overbought; uses 2% stoploss and trailing stop.

families.name: maqun
families.idea_html: maqun888: On a 5m timeframe, long entries come from multiple conditions including RSI6 below 40, RSI14 below 35, CCI oversold, close below the lower Bollinger band with above-average volume, close above EMA5 and MA5, SAR bullish while below the Bollinger mid, MACD histogram crossing above zero, ADX above 30, and a Bollinger mid cross. Exits are time-based: after 6 hours if the candle is not losing, and after 12 or 13 hours if losing 3% or 4%. Uses trailing stop and stoploss set to -1.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On a 5m timeframe, long entries come from the same multiple conditions: RSI6 below 40, RSI14 below 35, CCI oversold, close below the lower Bollinger band with volume, close above EMA5/MA5, SAR bullish below the Bollinger mid, MACD histogram crossing up, ADX above 30, and a Bollinger mid cross. It exits if the candle is losing 3% and the position has been held for 12 hours. Uses trailing stop and stoploss set to -1.

families.name: mark_strat
families.idea_html: mark_strat: Buys when close is below the lower Bollinger band and volume is positive. Exits when RSI is above 90, close is above the Bollinger middle band, and volume is positive. Uses a stepwise minimal ROI, a 23.9% stoploss, and trailing stop; timeframe is not specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Buys when ADX is above 49, fast stochastic is below 30, MFI is below 23, RSI is below 34, and close is below the 4-standard-deviation lower Bollinger band. Exits when ADX is below 95, fast stochastic is above 70, RSI is above 94, and SAR crosses above close. Uses a stepwise minimal ROI, 20.2% stoploss, and trailing stop.

families.name: ml_strategy
families.idea_html: ml_strategy: Uses an ML pipeline and Heikin-Ashi data. Buys when the Prediction column equals 1 and sells when Prediction equals 0. Uses a stepwise minimal ROI and 10% stoploss; timeframe is not specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: Uses RSI and Heikin-Ashi data. Buys when RSI is below 35 and sells when RSI crosses above 70. Uses a stepwise minimal ROI and 10% stoploss; timeframe is not specified.

families.name: myshortingstrategiembe
families.idea_html: myshortingstrategiembe1: On 5m, it uses Heikin-Ashi open/high/low and indicators including Ichimoku, EMA fan, volume MA, ATR, RSI, TEMA, and Bollinger middle. The main long buy requires price above the Ichimoku cloud, fan magnitude above 1 and gaining, volume above volume MA times multiplier, and ATR above its 20-period average. Additional long/short entries trigger on RSI crossing above 30 or below 70 with TEMA vs Bollinger middle guards, the exit is trend close crossing below a sell indicator, and risk uses -0.32 stoploss, trailing stop, shorting and a leverage hook.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it uses Heikin-Ashi open/high/low and indicators including Ichimoku, EMA fan, volume MA, ATR, RSI, TEMA, and Bollinger middle. The main long buy requires price above the Ichimoku cloud, fan magnitude above 1 and gaining, volume above volume MA times multiplier, and ATR above its 20-period average. Additional long/short entries trigger on RSI crossing above 30 or below 70 with TEMA vs Bollinger middle guards, the exit is trend close crossing below a sell indicator, and risk uses -0.22 stoploss, trailing stop, shorting and a leverage hook.

families.name: newVWAPstrat
families.idea_html: newVWAPstrat: On 5m, it calculates daily anchored VWAP, 150-period ATR, RSI 16, and 14-period Bollinger bands. It goes long when the 15-candle VWAP signal shows price above VWAP, RSI is below 45, and close (current and prior) is at or below the lower Bollinger band. It exits when close is at or above the upper band and RSI is above 55, and it also has a custom stoploss hook plus an ATR-based stoploss level.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5-minute timeframe, this strategy computes a daily VWAP trend signal over the last 15 candles, Bollinger Bands, RSI, and ATR. It enters long when the VWAP signal indicates an uptrend, RSI is below 45, and the close and prior close are at or below the lower Bollinger Band. It exits when the close is at or above the upper Bollinger Band and RSI is above 55, with an ATR-based custom stoploss and a minimal ROI target.

families.name: new_strat
families.idea_html: new_strat: On the 5-minute timeframe, this strategy uses a ZLEMA and a PMAX indicator. It enters long when the ZLEMA crosses above the PMAX line and exits when the ZLEMA crosses below it. The stoploss is set to -1 and there is no minimal ROI defined.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 4-hour timeframe, this strategy computes fast and slow SMA slopes, fast/slow SMAs, a short entry SMA, RSI, and a 10-bar lowest low. It enters long when both fast and slow slopes are positive, fast SMA is above slow SMA, close is above a shifted entry SMA, and RSI is above 55. It exits when fast SMA falls below slow SMA and close is below the prior 10-bar lowest low, with a trailing stop enabled.

families.name: new_turtle
families.idea_html: new_turtle: On the daily timeframe, this strategy builds average true range values and rolling N-bar highest high and lowest low levels. It enters long or short through precomputed enterLong/enterShort signals and exits on those signals or separate long/short exit conditions. A stoploss of -30 and a minimal ROI of 100 are set, with no trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the daily timeframe, this strategy uses average true range and rolling N-bar highest high and lowest low levels. It enters long through enterLong and short through enterShort signals, and exits long or short on separate Long_exit/Short_exit conditions. A stoploss of -0.3, minimal ROI of 100, and no trailing stop are set.

families.name: newstrategy_modify_support
families.idea_html: newstrategy_modify_support: On the 5-minute timeframe, this strategy computes BTC EMAs, Bollinger Bands and width, RMI, CCI, Stochastic RSI, RSI, and other indicators. It enters long on dip conditions when oscillators are low, close is below a lower Bollinger Band, and band-width and closedelta thresholds are met, with an additional similar dip signal and a truncated ROC condition. Position adjustment and custom stoploss hooks are enabled, and the shown exit code uses Fisher and Heikin-Ashi conditions but sets the sell/exit column to 0.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 5-minute timeframe, this strategy computes BTC EMAs, Bollinger Bands and width, RMI, CCI, Stochastic RSI, RSI, and other indicators. It enters long on dip conditions when oscillators are low, close is below a lower Bollinger Band, and band-width and closedelta thresholds are met, with an additional similar dip signal and a truncated ROC condition. Position adjustment and custom stoploss hooks are enabled, and the shown exit code uses Fisher and Heikin-Ashi conditions but sets the exit_long column to 0.

families.name: nexuslite
families.idea_html: nexuslite: On the 15-minute timeframe, this strategy computes RSI and Bollinger-style bands on RSI, plus TDFI and microtrend indicators. It enters long when RSI is below an upper RSI band and TDFI is below a negative silence threshold, or alternatively on RSI below lower/dispersion bands, TDFI below strike, TDFI equal to -1, or microtrend below 0. Exit conditions use RSI above dispersion/upper bands and TDFI above a threshold.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 15-minute timeframe, this strategy computes RSI and Bollinger-style bands on RSI, plus TDFI and microtrend indicators. It enters long when RSI is below an upper RSI band and TDFI is above a silence threshold, or alternatively on RSI below lower/dispersion bands, TDFI above strike, TDFI equal to -1, or microtrend below 0. Exit conditions use RSI above dispersion/upper bands and TDFI above a threshold.

families.name: rsibb
families.idea_html: rsibb: It buys when the close is below the lower Bollinger band while RSI is above 30, expecting price to move back toward the mean and avoiding deeply oversold RSI readings. It sells when the close rises above the Bollinger middle band. The minimal ROI dictionary is empty and the stoploss is set at -99%.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It buys when the close is below the lower Bollinger band while RSI is above 30, betting on a return toward the mean. It sells when the close is above the Bollinger middle band. The minimal ROI dictionary is empty and the stoploss is -99%.

families.name: s
families.idea_html: s06: Indicators come from add_all_ta_features, and entry and exit conditions are assembled in loops from runtime hyperopt parameters that name the indicator, comparison operator, crossed series and thresholds. The 12-hour timeframe strategy combines all generated conditions with an AND and relies on a minimal ROI ladder starting at 35.6% with a -34.5% stoploss and trailing stop.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On the 4-hour timeframe it builds a set of SMAs spaced by a growing gap and enters long only when every faster SMA is above the next slower SMA, at shifted bars. The exit mirrors this with the sell MA set, requiring the faster sell SMAs to be below the slower ones. A minimal ROI ladder beginning near 30.9% is used with a -12.8% stoploss.

families.name: sniper
families.idea_html: sniper: On 15m, it enters long when price crosses above VIDYA, the Aroon up line crosses above 77, and the TD Sequential count equals 9. It exits when Aroon down crosses below 68, Aroon up crosses below 24, and Ichimoku tenkan crosses below kijun. Stoploss is -0.5 and trailing_stop is False.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m, it enters long when StochRSI fast crosses above its signal and VFI crosses above zero, with optional EMA, VWMACD, StochRSI, VFI-MA and TKE conditions. Exits use optional EMA, VWMACD, StochRSI and VFI crosses along with a sell stochastic level. Trailing stop is True and stoploss is -0.288.

families.name: stochrsi
families.idea_html: stochrsi: On 1h, it enters long when EMA8 is above EMA15, EMA15 is above EMA50, close is above EMA8, and StochRSI K crosses above D. It exits when EMA15 falls below EMA50 or EMA8 falls below EMA15. It has a custom_stoploss hook and stores ATR for custom trade info.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1h with an informative timeframe, it enters long on EMA8 > EMA15 > EMA50, close above EMA8, and a StochRSI bullish cross. It exits when the EMA alignment breaks. ATR is used to set custom stop and ROI values, and a custom_stoploss hook is present.

families.name: strat
families.idea_html: strat3: On 5m, it computes many indicators including SAR, ADX, Stochastics, RSI, MFI, EMAs and Bollinger Bands. The entry rule is only a precomputed buysignal column, and the sell rule is disabled with & False. No concrete entry logic is visible in the fact sheet.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it detects bullish and bearish fair value gaps whose width exceeds an ATR-based filter. It enters long on a bull FVG when the 1h trend is up and market score > 60, and enters short on a bear FVG when the 1h trend is down and market score < 40. Exits occur on the opposite FVG, and position adjustment is enabled with an adjust_trade_position hook.

families.name: strato
families.idea_html: strato: On 1m candles, it computes a stochastic RSI-style K/D oscillator. It buys when K is below 18 and K is at or above D, and sells when K is above 80 and D is at or above K. It has a -0.1 stoploss and a minimal ROI of 0.012.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It computes lower Bollinger bands with window 21 and 2.7 standard deviations, and upper bands with window 21 and 3 standard deviations. It buys when the average of close and low is below the lower band, and sells when high exceeds the upper band. It uses a -0.0021 stoploss and a minimal ROI ladder.

families.name: tacos
families.idea_html: tacos: On 1d candles, it computes a WaveTrend-style oscillator and RSI moving-average slope. It buys when wave_t1 is at or above wave_t2, RSI_MA is within buy bounds, and RSI_MA slope is positive. It sells when wave_t1 percent change is below a sell threshold, RSI_MA is within sell bounds, and RSI_MA slope is non-positive. It has a -0.015 stoploss and a minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: It computes Heikin-Ashi candles and SMA columns over HA open/close for parameter ranges. The entry and exit reference parameterized ema_b* and ema_s* columns in crossed_above conditions with a volume > 0 filter, but those columns are not defined in the shown indicator code. It runs on 6h candles, has a -0.03 stoploss, and a minimal ROI of 0.10.

families.name: test_ema
families.idea_html: test_ema: This 5m strategy computes and prints MACD, EMA and SMA values but defines no entry or exit conditions; the buy and sell signals are set unconditionally. It uses a minimal ROI of 1 and a stoploss of -0.1, with no trailing stop specified.

other_descriptions.idea_html: This 5m strategy computes and prints MACD histogram, EMA and SMA values on two data slices but defines no entry or exit conditions; the buy and sell signals are set unconditionally. It uses a minimal ROI of 1 and a stoploss of -0.1.

families.name: thetank
families.idea_html: thetank2: On 15m, it enters long when the 1h 200-SMA is falling and WaveTrend t1 is below a bear threshold and rising, either crossing above WaveTrend t2 with TTM Squeeze on, or turning up without the cross. A third transition entry drops the Squeeze condition. It exits on Squeeze/WaveTrend transitions, WaveTrend t2 crossing above t1, or RSI above a sell level. It uses trailing stop, custom stoploss, DCA up to two adjustments, -9% stoploss, and minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m, it enters long when ZEMA crosses above pivot support S3 or S2, or in a TTM Squeeze when price is above ZEMA but below R2, RSI is below a bear threshold with its moving average rising, 200-SMA is falling, and WaveTrend t1 is below a bear threshold, rising, and crosses above its signal. It exits when ZEMA crosses below R3, R2.75, or R2.50. It uses trailing stop, custom stoploss, -9% stoploss, minimal ROI, and position adjustment is enabled with max entry adjustment zero.

families.name: true_lambo
families.idea_html: true_lambo: On 5m, it builds several buy setups: a crash setup requiring tpct_0, tpct_3, and tpct_9 below thresholds; a cofi setup requiring open below EMA8, fastk crossing above fastd while both are below thresholds, ADX above a level, and EWO above a high value; and a gumbo setup using 1h Bollinger middle vs T3, price below EMA8, CTI, R14, EWO, and tpct conditions. It exits when close is above SMA9 and an MA sell level with RSI>50 and RSI fast>slow, or when SMA9 is rising while close is below HMA50 and above an MA sell level. It has custom sell/custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss, and minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m, it builds several buy setups: a crash setup requiring tpct_0, tpct_3, and tpct_9 below thresholds; a cofi setup requiring open below EMA8, fastk crossing above fastd while both are below thresholds, ADX above a level, and EWO above a high value; and a gumbo setup using 1h Bollinger middle vs T3, price below EMA8, CTI, R14, EWO, and tpct conditions. It exits when close is above SMA9 and an MA sell level with RSI>50 and RSI fast>slow, or when SMA9 is rising while close is below HMA50 and above an MA sell level. It has custom sell/custom stoploss, a -0.99 stoploss, and minimal ROI.

families.name: twinturbo
families.idea_html: twinturboV8: On 5m candles, it enters long when price is below an EMA offset, EWO is in a configured range and rising, and RSI/fast RSI are below their buy thresholds. It exits on strength above HMA50 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or an alternate close/HMA condition. It has a -25% stoploss, an ROI table, and position adjustment hooks.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it enters long when price is below an EMA offset, EWO is in a configured range and rising, and RSI/fast RSI are below their buy thresholds. It exits on strength above HMA50 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or an alternate close/HMA condition. It has a -25% stoploss, an ROI table, and custom entry price, sell, stoploss, and adjustment hooks.

families.name: vinfast
families.idea_html: vinfast4: On 5m candles, it buys dips below an EMA offset when EWO is above a threshold, RSI and fast RSI are low, and vol_base is below -80, with a pump-protection filter. It exits when price is above SMA9 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50, or under an alternate lower-HMA condition. It uses a -15% stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 5m candles, it buys when price is below the shifted lower Bollinger band with band/close delta and candle-tail filters while EMA10 is above EMA100, or when price is below 0.993 of the lower band and volume is below a slow average. It exits on SMA9/sell-EMA strength with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or under an alternate lower-HMA condition. It uses a -15% stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI.

families.name: vulcan
families.idea_html: vulcan: On 30m candles, it enters long when close is above a rising 23-period SMA and RSI is above its 50-period average and above 50. It exits when slow stochastic crosses down from above 75 or when close makes a new 100-bar low. It has a -25% stoploss and no ROI exit.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 4h candles, it enters long when close is above a rising 23-period SMA and RSI is above its 50-period average and above 66. It exits when slow stochastic crosses down from above 75 or when close makes a new 100-bar low. It has a -32% stoploss and no ROI exit.

families.name: wavetrend
families.idea_html: wavetrend: On 1h candles, it enters when WaveTrend wave_t1 crosses above wave_t2 and is rising, or when RSI crosses above its moving average within configured RSI bounds. It exits when RSI/WaveTrend cross down after RSI is above the sell threshold. It has a -40% stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and position adjustment up to 2.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 1h candles, it enters when RSI is above its moving average and within the configured buy range, while WaveTrend wave_t1 is rising and crosses above wave_t2. It exits when RSI is above the sell threshold and WaveTrend wave_t2 crosses above wave_t1. It has a -40% stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and position adjustment up to 3.

families.name: yabar_bbrsi
families.idea_html: yabar_bbrsi: On 15m candles, it buys when price is below the lower Bollinger band with RSI above 35, or below the middle band with RSI below 62. There is no sell signal in the exit code, so exits rely on ROI and the custom stoploss hook. It has a -99% stoploss and a multi-step minimal ROI.

other_descriptions.idea_html: On 15m candles, it buys when RSI is below 35 and close is below the lower Bollinger band. There is no sell signal in the exit code, so exits rely on ROI and the custom stoploss hook. It has a -99% stoploss and a single 10% minimal ROI target.
